events.summary: After President of Peru Pedro Castillo was ousted on 7 December 2022, a series of political protests against the government of President Dina Boluarte and the Congress of Peru occurred.

events.title: 2022 Nevis Island Assembly election
events.summary: Island Assembly elections were held in Nevis on 12 December 2022 to elect five members of the Nevis Island Assembly.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Czechia.

events.title: Leo Varadkar takes power
events.summary: Leo Eric Varadkar is an Irish former Fine Gael politician who served as Taoiseach from 2017 to 2020 and from 2022 to 2024, as Tánaiste from 2020 to 2022, and as leader of Fine Gael from 2017 to 2024. A TD for the Dublin West constituency from 2007 to 2024, he held a range of other ministerial positions from 2011 to 2024.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Uganda vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Uganda and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2022-12-21. This episode was active in 1 year (2022–2022), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2022-12-27.

events.title: Borjana Krišto takes power
events.summary: Borjana Krišto is a Bosnian Croat politician who has served as Chairwoman of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina since January 2023. She previously served as president of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina from 2007 to 2011. She is the first woman to hold both positions.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Angola vs FLEC-FAC-TN (Cabinda)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Angola and FLEC-FAC-TN over control of Cabinda, starting 2022-12-31. This episode was active in 1 year (2022–2022), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2022-12-31.

events.title: Third inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
events.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Geraldo Alckmin were inaugurated as 39th president of Brazil and 26th vice president, respectively, on 1 January 2023, in a ceremony held in the National Congress in Brasília, beginning the third Lula administration.

events.title: Coup: 8 January Brasília attacks
events.summary: On 8 January 2023, following the defeat of president Jair Bolsonaro in the 2022 Brazilian general election and the inauguration of his successor Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a mob of Bolsonaro's supporters attacked Brazil's federal government buildings in the capital, Brasília.

events.title: 2023 Antiguan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 18 January 2023 to elect members of the House of Representatives. The Labour Party (ABLP) has held an absolute majority of 15 seats in the House of Representatives after the 2018 general election, with Gaston Browne remaining as prime minister.

events.title: 2023 Trinidad and Tobago presidential election
events.summary: Indirect presidential elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 20 January 2023.

events.title: 2023 Slovak constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Slovakia on 21 January 2023. Following the 2020 parliamentary election, in which the Direction – Slovak Social Democracy (SMER) was defeated by the Ordinary People and Independent Personalities (OĽaNO), opposition parties initiated a referendum to call a snap election.

events.title: 2023 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election
events.summary: The 2023 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election was held on 22 January 2023 to choose the next leader of the New Zealand Labour Party. The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister and Labour Party Leader Jacinda Ardern, which was announced on 19 January 2023.

events.title: 2023 Czech presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in the Czech Republic in January 2023, resulting in the election of Petr Pavel. Incumbent president Miloš Zeman was not eligible to run due to the two-term limit.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2023 Neve Yaakov shooting
events.summary: On 27 January 2023, a Palestinian gunman killed at least seven civilians in the Israeli settlement of Neve Yaakov, in East Jerusalem, the occupied West Bank. The suspect is also reported as having shot at worshippers exiting a synagogue, and, according to the police, was shot and killed after he opened fire on the attending officers.

events.title: 2023 Liechtenstein constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Liechtenstein on 29 January 2023. Voters voted on a proposal to ban casinos, with 73% voting against the proposal. If a ban had been approved, casinos in Liechtenstein would have been closed and banned by 2028.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2023 Peshawar mosque bombing
events.summary: On 30 January 2023, at around 1:30 p.m. Pakistan Standard Time (UTC+5), a suicide bomber set off an explosion within the Police Lines mosque of Peshawar in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, killing 84 people and injuring 217.

events.title: Su Tseng-chang resigns as Premier of the Republic of China
events.summary: Su Tseng-chang resigned as Premier of the Republic of China on 31 January 2023, having held the office since 14 January 2019.

events.title: 2023 Cypriot presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 5 February 2023. No candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, so a runoff was held on 12 February.

events.title: 2023 Monegasque general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Monaco on 5 February 2023. The result was a landslide victory for the governing Monegasque National Union led by Brigitte Boccone-Pagès, which won all 24 seats on the National Council. The new council was sworn in on 16 February.

events.title: 2023 South Ethiopia Region referendum
events.summary: On 6 February 2023 a referendum was held in the Wolayita, Gamo, Gofa, South Omo, Gedeo, and Konso Zones, as well as the Dirashe, Amaro, Burji, Ale, and Basketo special woredas of the Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region (SNNP) of Ethiopia, on whether the included areas should leave SNNP and form their own Region.

events.title: Earthquake: 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquakes
events.summary: On 6 February 2023, two earthquakes devastated southern and central Turkey and northern and western Syria. The first earthquake occurred at 04:17:35 TRT (01:17:35 UTC), measuring moment magnitude (Mw) of 7.8. The epicenter was 37 km (23 mi) west–northwest of Gaziantep.

events.title: 2023 visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy to the United Kingdom
events.summary: On 8 February 2023, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the president of Ukraine, visited the United Kingdom. During his trip, Zelenskyy met Rishi Sunak, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom at the time. He also addressed members of parliament from Westminster Hall in the Houses of Parliament and had an audience with King Charles III.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Sweden.

events.title: Nicos Christodoulides takes power
events.summary: Nikos Christodoulides is a Cypriot politician, diplomat, and academic who has served as the 8th President of Cyprus since 2023. He previously served as Government Spokesman from 2014 to 2018 and Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2018 to 2022, both under his predecessor Nicos Anastasiades.

events.title: 2023 Scottish National Party leadership election
events.summary: The 2023 Scottish National Party leadership election took place in February and March 2023 to choose the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP) to succeed Nicola Sturgeon, who announced her resignation on 15 February.

events.title: 2023 visit by Joe Biden to Ukraine
events.summary: On February 20, 2023, the president of the United States, Joe Biden, made a visit to Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, following the beginning of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Out of security concerns, his travel plans had not been made public prior to his arrival, and only two journalists accompanied him, having been sworn to secrecy three days earlier.

events.title: 2023 Democratic Party leadership election
events.summary: The 2023 Democratic Party leadership election was a primary election that was held in Italy in February 2023 to elect the National Assembly and secretary of the Italian Democratic Party (PD). It consisted of a closed primary election among party members held from 9 to 19 February, and an open primary election held on 26 February.

events.title: Assassination: Pamplona massacre
events.summary: The Pamplona massacre was a mass shooting and assassination incident that took place in Pamplona, Negros Oriental, Philippines. On March 4, 2023, at approximately 9:36 a.m. (PhST), a group of armed men stormed the residence of Roel Degamo, the governor of Negros Oriental, killing him as well as nine others.

events.title: Treaty signed: High Seas Treaty
events.summary: The Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction or BBNJ Agreement, commonly known as the High Seas Treaty, is a legally binding instrument for the conservation and sustainable use of marine biological diversity of areas beyond…

events.title: 2023 Estonian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 5 March 2023 to elect all 101 members of the Riigikogu. The officially published election data indicate the victory of the Reform Party, which won 37 seats in total, while the Conservative People's Party of Estonia (EKRE) placed second with 17 seats.

events.title: 2023–2024 Georgian protests
events.summary: In 2023 and 2024, a series of street demonstrations took place throughout Georgia largely in opposition to the proposed "Law on Transparency of Foreign Influence", which would require non-governmental organizations (NGOs) to register as foreign agents or "organizations carrying the interests of a foreign power" and disclose the sources of their income if…

events.title: Inauguration of Petr Pavel
events.summary: The inauguration of Petr Pavel as President of the Czech Republic took place on 9 March 2023 at a ceremonial joint meeting of both chambers of the Parliament of the Czech Republic in the Vladislav Hall of Prague Castle. This is the seventh inauguration in the history of the independent Czech Republic.

events.title: 2023 Chinese presidential election
events.summary: The first session of the 14th National People's Congress was held in March 2023 at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, China. The session opened on 5 March and concluded on 13 March. Major state positions of China were elected in this session.

events.title: ICC arrest warrants for Russian leaders
events.summary: On 17 March 2023, following an investigation of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide, the International Criminal Court (ICC) issued arrest warrants for Vladimir Putin, the president of Russia, and Maria Lvova-Belova, Russian commissioner for children's rights, alleging responsibility for the war crime of unlawful deportation and transfer of…

events.title: 2023 visit by Fumio Kishida to Ukraine
events.summary: On 21 March 2023, Fumio Kishida, the Prime Minister of Japan, visited Ukraine. This was the first visit to Ukraine by the Prime Minister since the beginning of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council. Council presidency: Sweden.

events.title: 2023 Turkish presidential election candidate nominations
events.summary: In the lead up to the 2023 Turkish presidential election, discussions took place around the nomination of presidential candidates.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Sweden.

events.title: European Council meeting (euro summit)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (euro summit meeting). Council presidency: Sweden.

events.title: 2023 Cuban parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 26 March 2023 to elect members of the National Assembly of People's Power.

events.title: 2023 Berlin climate neutrality referendum
events.summary: The 2023 Berlin climate neutrality referendum, also referred to as Berlin 2030 climate-neutral, was a citizens' initiative launched in Berlin in 2018. It was the subject of a city-wide referendum on 26 March 2023, commonly called the Klima-Volksentscheid. Voters were asked whether the Climate Protection and Energy Transition Act of 2016 should be amended.

events.title: Nicola Sturgeon resigns as First Minister of Scotland
events.summary: Nicola Sturgeon resigned as First Minister of Scotland on 28 March 2023, having held the office since 20 November 2014.

events.title: 2023 Andorran parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Andorra on 2 April 2023. The ruling liberal-conservative coalition of the Democrats for Andorra (DA) and Committed Citizens (CC) led by Prime Minister Xavier Espot won an absolute majority of seats, the fourth consecutive election victory for the DA.

events.title: 2023 Bulgarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in Bulgaria on 2 April 2023 to elect members of the National Assembly. These were initially scheduled to be held before November 2026; however, as no government was approved by the 48th Parliament, Bulgarian President Rumen Radev announced in January 2023 that he would call a snap election.

events.title: 2023 Finnish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 2 April 2023 to elect members of the Parliament of Finland.

events.title: 2023 Montenegrin presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Montenegro on 19 March 2023. Long-ruling incumbent president Milo Đukanović was eligible for re-election. Since no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round vote was held on 2 April. In the first round, Đukanović, leader of the populist DPS, received 35%, coming first.

events.title: Assassination of Vladlen Tatarsky
events.summary: On 2 April 2023, a bombing occurred in the Street Food Bar No.1 café on Universitetskaya Embankment in Saint Petersburg, Russia. Russian military blogger Vladlen Tatarsky, real name Maxim Fomin, died as a result of the explosion and 42 people were injured, 24 of whom were hospitalized, including six in critical conditions.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Attempted assassination of Fumio Kishida
events.summary: On 15 April 2023, a pipe bomb exploded near Fumio Kishida, the then-prime minister of Japan, who came to the fishing port of Saikazaki, Wakayama, Wakayama Prefecture, in the Kansai region to give a campaign stump speech for the 2023 Wakayama 1st district by-election. Just before Kishida was to give a stump speech, a man threw a pipe bomb.

events.title: Coup: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
events.summary: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF)…

events.title: Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)
events.summary: The Battle of Khartoum was a major strategic battle for control of Khartoum, the capital of Sudan, with fighting in and around the city between the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), and the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), as part of the civil war.

events.title: 2023 Cuban presidential election
events.summary: An indirect presidential election was held in Cuba on 19 April 2023. The election took place following the election to the National Assembly of People's Power on 26 March 2023.

events.title: Dominic Raab resigns as Lord Chancellor, Deputy Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Secretary of State for Justice
events.summary: Dominic Raab resigned as Lord Chancellor, Deputy Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Secretary of State for Justice on 21 April 2023, having held office since 15 September 2021.

events.title: 2023 Uzbek constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Uzbekistan on 30 April 2023. It was to be held on proposed constitutional amendments.

events.title: 2023 Writers Guild of America strike
events.summary: From May 2 to September 27, 2023, the Writers Guild of America (WGA)—representing 11,500 screenwriters—went on strike over a labor dispute with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP). Lasting 148 days, the strike is tied with the 1960 strike as the second-longest labor stoppage actioned by the WGA, only behind the 1988 strike.

events.title: 2023 Hollywood labor disputes
events.summary: From May 2 to November 9, 2023, a series of long labor disputes within the film and television industries of the United States took place, mainly focused on the strikes of the Writers Guild of America and SAG-AFTRA.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Mladenovac and Smederevo shootings
events.summary: On the evening of 4 May 2023, a shooting spree occurred in the villages of Dubona and Malo Orašje, between Mladenovac and Smederevo, Serbia. Armed with an automatic assault rifle, the shooter opened fire from a car, resulting in the deaths of nine individuals, including an off-duty police officer, and leaving thirteen others injured.

events.title: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2023
events.summary: The coronation of Charles III and his wife, Camilla, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the 14 other Commonwealth realms, took place on Saturday, 6 May 2023 at Westminster Abbey. Charles acceded to the throne on 8 September 2022 upon the death of his mother, Elizabeth II.

events.title: Coronation of Charles III and Camilla
events.summary: The coronation of Charles III and his wife, Camilla, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the 14 other Commonwealth realms, took place on Saturday, 6 May 2023 at Westminster Abbey. Charles acceded to the throne on 8 September 2022 upon the death of his mother, Elizabeth II.

events.title: 2023 Turkish presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Turkey in May 2023, alongside parliamentary elections, to elect a president for a term of five years. Dubbed the most important election of 2023, the presidential election went to a run-off for the first time in Turkish history.

events.title: 2023 Turkish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Turkey on 14 May 2023, alongside presidential elections, to elect all 600 members of the Grand National Assembly. The incoming members formed the 28th Parliament of Turkey.

events.title: Ľudovít Ódor takes power
events.summary: Ľudovít Ódor is a Slovak economist and politician who served as Prime Minister of Slovakia from May to October 2023, heading a technocratic cabinet. From July to October 2023, he also served as Minister of the Interior. Prior to his appointment as prime minister, Ódor served as Deputy Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia, from 2018 to 2023.

events.title: 49th G7 summit
events.summary: The 49th G7 summit was held from 19 to 21 May 2023 in the city of Hiroshima in Hiroshima Prefecture.

events.title: 2023 Arab League summit
events.summary: The 2023 Arab League summit, officially the 32nd Ordinary Session of the Council of the League of Arab States at the Summit Level, was a meeting of heads of state and government of member states of the League of Arab States that took place in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on 19 May 2023.

events.title: May 2023 Greek parliamentary election
events.summary: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 21 May 2023 to elect all 300 members of the Hellenic Parliament. They were the first elections since 1990 to be held without a seat bonus, due to amendments to the electoral law made in 2016. The elections instead used a system of proportional representation.

events.title: Presidential & parliamentary elections
events.summary: Political Atlas, checked 25 October 2026.

events.title: 2023 South American summit
events.summary: The 2023 South American summit was a summit organized and hosted by the government of Brazil "to deal with the importance of seeking collective solutions in the name of a common destiny and to reposition the region as an important actor on the global stage". The summit was held on May 30, 2023, in the city of Brasília.

events.title: 2023 Dutch Senate election
events.summary: An election to the Dutch Senate was held on 30 May 2023. The 75 members of the Senate were elected by members of the provincial councils and electoral colleges elected two months earlier in provincial and electoral college elections.

events.title: 2023 Latvian presidential election
events.summary: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 31 May 2023 to elect the President of Latvia, who is the country's head of state.

events.title: 2nd European Political Community Summit
events.summary: The Second European Political Community Summit was a meeting of the European Political Community held on 1 June 2023 at Mimi Castle, Bulboaca, 35 kilometres from Chișinău, Moldova. It was attended by forty-five heads of states and governments, as well as leaders of European Union institutions.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Russia vs LSR, RDK, Wagner
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Russia (Soviet Union) and LSR, RDK, Wagner over control of the government, starting 2023-06-01. This episode was active in 2 years (2023–2024), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2024-03-25.

events.title: Third inauguration of Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
events.summary: The third inauguration of Recep Tayyip Erdoğan as the president of Turkey took place on Saturday, 3 June 2023, at the Presidential Complex in Ankara.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Cameroon vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Cameroon and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2023-06-05. This episode was active in 1 year (2023–2023), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2023-12-17.

events.title: Nikolai Denkov takes power
events.summary: Nikolai Denkov Denkov is a Bulgarian politician who served as Prime Minister of Bulgaria from 2023 to 2024. A member of the PP party, he previously served as Member of the National Assembly from 2022 to 2023 and as Minister of Education and Science in 2017 and from 2021 to 2022. Denkov is a physicist, physical chemist and chemist.

events.title: 2023 Montenegrin parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Montenegro on 11 June 2023. Parliament had been dissolved by President Milo Đukanović just three days before the 2023 presidential elections were held, in which he lost to Europe Now! candidate Jakov Milatović.

events.title: 2023 Plaid Cymru leadership election
events.summary: The 2023 Plaid Cymru leadership election was triggered by the resignation of Adam Price as party leader on 16 May, after an internal report found the party to have a "culture of harassment, bullying and misogyny". Rhun ap Iorwerth became leader on 16 June 2023 unopposed.

events.title: 2023 Malian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Mali on 18 June 2023. It was initially scheduled for 9 July 2017. However, in late June 2017 it was postponed with no date set, before being revived in mid-April 2021, with a date set of 31 October 2021. Due to the 2021 Malian coup d'état it was indefinitely postponed, with plans for it to be held by 2024.

events.title: Opinion polling for the 2023 Turkish parliamentary election
events.summary: In the run up to the 2023 Turkish parliamentary election, held on 14 May, various organizations carried out opinion polling to gauge voting intention in Turkey. Results of such polls are displayed in this article. These polls only include Turkish voters nationwide and do not take into account Turkish expatriates voting abroad.

events.title: Petteri Orpo takes power
events.summary: Antti Petteri Orpo is a Finnish politician currently serving as the prime minister of Finland since 2023. He has also been the leader of the National Coalition Party since 2016 and briefly served as speaker of the Parliament of Finland after the 2023 parliamentary election.

events.title: Támara prison riot
events.summary: On 20 June 2023, a prison riot broke out in the Women's Center for Social Adaptation, a women's prison located in Támara, Honduras, about 29 km (18 mi) northwest from Tegucigalpa, the nation's capital. The riot is suspected to be the result of a conflict between female members of the MS-13 and 18th Street gangs.

events.title: Coup: Wagner Group rebellion
events.summary: On 23 June 2023, the Wagner Group, a Russian private military company, staged an uprising against the Russian government. It marked the climax of the Wagner Group–Ministry of Defense conflict, which had begun about six months earlier.

events.title: June 2023 Greek parliamentary election
events.summary: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 25 June 2023. All 300 seats in the Hellenic Parliament were contested.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Ethiopia vs Fano (Amhara)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Ethiopia and Fano over territory and government, starting 2023-06-27. This episode was active in 3 years (2023–2025), 3 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Nahel Merzouk riots
events.summary: A series of riots in France began on 27 June 2023 following the fatal shooting of Nahel Merzouk in an encounter with two police officers in Nanterre, a suburb of Paris.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Sweden.

events.title: Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard
events.summary: Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard, 600 U.S. 181 (2023), is a landmark decision of the United States Supreme Court ruling that race-based affirmative action programs in most college admissions violate the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment. With its companion case, Students for Fair Admissions v.

events.title: 2023 Vilnius NATO summit
events.summary: The 2023 Vilnius summit was the formal meeting of the heads of state and heads of government of the thirty-one members of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), their partner countries, and the European Union, held in Vilnius, Lithuania, on 11–12 July 2023.

events.title: Gabriela Firea resigns as Minister of Family, Youth and Equal Opportunities
events.summary: Gabriela Firea resigned as Minister of Family, Youth and Equal Opportunities on 14 July 2023, having held the office since 25 November 2021.

events.title: 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike
events.summary: From July 14 to November 9, 2023, the American actors' union Screen Actors Guild–American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA) went on strike over a labor dispute with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP). It was the longest actors' strike against the film and TV studios in Hollywood history.

events.title: 2023 Spanish general election
events.summary: A general election was held in Spain on 23 July 2023 to elect the members of the 15th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. It was the first time since 1839 that a general election in Spain was held in the month of July.

events.title: 2023 visit by Yoon Suk Yeol to Ukraine
events.summary: On 15 July 2023, President Yoon Suk Yeol visited Ukraine after visiting Lithuania and Poland for the NATO summit. He visited Bucha and Irpin, small cities near the capital city of Kyiv. He laid flowers on the monument.

events.title: Coup: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état
events.summary: On 26 July 2023, a coup d'état occurred in Niger when the presidential guard detained President Mohamed Bazoum, and presidential guard commander General Abdourahamane Tiani proclaimed himself the leader of a military junta shortly after confirming the coup a success.

events.title: 2023 Russia–Africa Summit
events.summary: The 2023 Russia–Africa Summit was the second Russia–Africa Summit, held at the Expoforum in Saint Petersburg, Russia, on 27 and 28 July 2023. It had originally been scheduled for October 2022 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, but was postponed.

events.title: 2023 Central African constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in the Central African Republic on 30 July 2023, proposing, among other things, to abolish term limits for the president and increasing presidential terms from five years to seven years.

events.title: Judit Varga resigns as Minister of Justice of Hungary
events.summary: Judit Varga resigned as Minister of Justice of Hungary on 31 July 2023, having held the office since 12 July 2019.

events.title: Coup: 2023 Sierra Leone coup plot
events.summary: On 31 July 2023, Sierra Leonean authorities detained an undetermined number of soldiers and civilians who were allegedly planning a coup in Sierra Leone between 7 and 10 August against the government of Julius Maada Bio.

events.title: 2023 Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization Summit
events.summary: The 2023 Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization Summit, also known as the 2023 Amazon countries summit or the 2023 Amazon Summit, was a multilateral event which took place from 8 to 9, August 2023 in the Brazilian city of Belém.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Chad vs CCMSR
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Chad and CCMSR over control of the government, starting 2023-08-09. This episode was active in 1 year (2023–2023), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2023-09-09.

events.title: Assassination of Fernando Villavicencio
events.summary: On 9 August 2023, eleven days before the 2023 Ecuadorian general election, presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio was assassinated after leaving a campaign rally in Quito, the capital of Ecuador. One assailant was killed during the attack. Several bystanders, including security personnel and a legislative candidate, were injured.

events.title: General election
events.summary: Political Atlas, checked 25 October 2026.

events.title: 15th BRICS summit
events.summary: The 2023 BRICS summit was the fifteenth annual BRICS summit, an international relations conference attended by the heads of state or heads of government of the five member states: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa. South African President Cyril Ramaphosa also invited the leaders of 67 countries to the summit.

events.title: Coup: 2023 Gabonese coup d'état
events.summary: On 30 August 2023, a coup d'état occurred in Gabon shortly after the announcement that incumbent president Ali Bongo had won the general election held on 26 August. It was the eighth successful coup to occur in West and Central Africa since 2020.

events.title: 2023 Democratic Party for the People leadership election
events.summary: The 2023 Democratic Party For the People leadership election was held on 2 September 2023 in accordance with the end of the presidential term which had commenced in 2020. Incumbent president Yuichiro Tamaki was re-elected overwhelmingly against former foreign minister Seiji Maehara.

events.title: Earthquake: 2023 Al Haouz earthquake
events.summary: On 8 September 2023 at 23:11 DST, an earthquake with a moment magnitude of 6.9 and maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent) struck Morocco's Al Haouz Province. The earthquake's epicenter was 73.4 km (45.6 mi) southwest of Marrakesh, near the town of Ighil and the Oukaïmeden ski resort in the Atlas Mountains.

events.title: 2023 G20 New Delhi summit
events.summary: The 2023 G20 New Delhi summit was the eighteenth meeting of the G20, a Head of State and Government meeting held at Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi on 9–10 September 2023. It was the first G20 summit held in India.

events.title: 2023 Yaroslavl Oblast Duma election
events.summary: The 2023 Yaroslavl Oblast Duma election took place on 8–10 September 2023, on common election day. All 46 seats in the Oblast Duma were up for reelection.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Mali vs FLA (Azawad)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Mali and FLA over territory and government, starting 2023-09-12. This episode was active in 3 years (2023–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2023 visit by Kim Jong Un to Russia
events.summary: On 12–17 September, 2023, Kim Jong Un, the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the president of the State Affairs Commission, visited Russia.

events.title: Evika Siliņa takes power
events.summary: Evika Siliņa is a Latvian politician who served as prime minister of Latvia from 2023 to 2026. From 2022 to 2023, she served as Minister of Welfare in the second cabinet of prime minister Krišjānis Kariņš. She is a member of the Unity political party, a member of the New Unity alliance, and the second female head of government of Latvia.

events.title: Treaty signed: Alliance of Sahel States
events.summary: The Alliance of Sahel States is a political and economic union in the Sahel region of Africa comprising Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger. It originated as a mutual defense pact in 2023. All three member states are under the control of military juntas following a string of successful coups.

events.title: 2023 French Senate election
events.summary: Senatorial elections took place on 24 September 2023 to renew 170 of the 348 seats in the Senate of the French Fifth Republic. The Republicans, led by Bruno Retailleau, emerged as the largest group for the fourth consecutive cycle, but lost 12 seats.

events.title: Coup: 2023 Burkina Faso coup attempt
events.summary: On 26 September 2023, dissidents of the Burkina Faso Armed Forces attempted to overthrow the ruling military junta led by Ibrahim Traoré, who came to power a year earlier.

events.title: 2023 Dominican presidential election
events.summary: An indirect presidential election was held on 27 September 2023 to elect the next President of Dominica.

events.title: 2023 Slovak parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in the Slovak Republic on 30 September 2023 to elect members of the National Council. Regular elections were scheduled to be held in 2024. However, on 15 December 2022, the government lost a no-confidence vote.

events.title: APEC Indonesia 2013
events.summary: The APEC Indonesia 2013 was the 25th annual gathering of APEC leaders. It was held in Bali on 5–7 October 2013. The summit also saw the revival of wearing national dress, which had been explicitly discontinued by US President Barack Obama two years prior.

events.title: 3rd European Political Community Summit
events.summary: The Third European Political Community Summit was a meeting of the European Political Community held on 5 October 2023 at the Granada Conference Centre in Granada, Spain.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Hroza missile attack
events.summary: On 5 October 2023, the Russian Armed Forces launched an Iskander ballistic missile at residents gathered in a memorial service at a shop and cafe in Hroza, Kupiansk Raion, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine, killing 59 and injuring at least 7 others. Among those killed in the airstrike was a six-year-old boy.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: Earthquake: 2023 Herat earthquakes
events.summary: Four large earthquakes measuring Mww 6.3 each and their aftershocks affected Herat Province in western Afghanistan in early October 2023. The first two earthquakes occurred on 7 October at 11:11 AFT and 11:42 AFT near the city of Herat, followed by many aftershocks. On 11 and 15 October, two other magnitude 6.3 earthquakes struck the same area.

events.title: Battle of Re'im
events.summary: The battle of Re'im took place on October 7, 2023, when Hamas attacked Israel, initiating the Gaza war. At 10:00 am, less than five hours after Hamas attacked, fighting was reported outside of the Re'im Army Base, which is headquarters for the Gaza Division.

events.title: Battle of Sderot
events.summary: The battle of Sderot began on 7 October 2023, when Hamas launched a large-scale surprise attack on southern Israel, which was widely condemned as an act of terrorism.

events.title: Battle: Nahal Oz attack
events.summary: The kibbutz of Nahal Oz and the adjacent military base near the northern Gaza Strip were attacked in 2023 as part of the October 7 attacks. In the attack, more than 60 Israeli soldiers and 15 civilians were killed. Some soldiers and eight civilians were kidnapped and taken to the Gaza Strip.

events.title: Terrorist attack: October 7 attacks
events.summary: On October 7, 2023, a series of coordinated armed incursions from the blockaded Gaza Strip into the Gaza envelope of southern Israel were carried out by Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups. In response, Israel launched a major military operation in Gaza.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Nova music festival massacre
events.summary: On 7 October 2023, the al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of the Palestinian nationalist and Islamist political organization Hamas, initiated a sudden attack on Israel from the Gaza Strip.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Netiv HaAsara massacre
events.summary: The Netiv HaAsara massacre occurred during the October 7 attacks. Three Hamas fighters on paragliders attacked Netiv HaAsara, an Israeli moshav close to the border fence. The militants killed at least 17 people. Before the massacre, the moshav was home to approximately 900 residents.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Be'eri massacre
events.summary: During the October 7 attacks on Israel, Hamas militants carried out a massacre at Be'eri, a kibbutz near the Gaza Strip. Hundreds of Gazan militants and civilian looters attacked the kibbutz, killing and abducting civilians while facing resistance from armed residents. Israeli security forces regained control by the evening of 8 October.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Kfar Aza massacre
events.summary: On 7 October 2023, around 250 Hamas and other Palestinian militants attacked Kfar Aza, an Israeli kibbutz about 3 kilometers (1.9 mi) from the border with the Gaza Strip, massacring residents and abducting hostages.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Nir Oz attack
events.summary: On 7 October 2023, as part of the surprise attack on Israel, Palestinian militants from the Gaza Strip, led by Hamas, invaded the Nir Oz kibbutz in southern Israel. They killed scores of kibbutz residents, burned homes, and abducted civilians. Over 500 Palestinian militants and civilian looters participated in the massacre.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Alumim massacre
events.summary: On 7 October 2023, dozens of Hamas militants attacked Alumim, a kibbutz close to the border fence with the Gaza Strip, as part of the surprise attack on Israel. There were 41 Thai and Nepalese foreigners working at the kibbutz. The militants killed between 16 and 17 of these workers and kidnapped between five and eight of them.

events.title: Hamas-led attack on Israel; Gaza war begins
events.summary: On October 7, 2023, a series of coordinated armed incursions from the blockaded Gaza Strip into the Gaza envelope of southern Israel were carried out by Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups. In response, Israel launched a major military operation in Gaza.

events.title: Battle: Zikim attack
events.summary: As part of the 7 October 2023 attack on Israel from the Gaza Strip, a military engagement took place near Zikim, Israel between Hamas militants and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). According to Haaretz, Hamas's goal was to capture Zikim's military training base.

events.title: 2023 Luxembourg general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Luxembourg on 8 October 2023 to elect all 60 seats of the Chamber of Deputies.

events.title: Gaza war protests
events.summary: The Gaza war has sparked protests, demonstrations, and vigils around the world. These protests focused on a variety of issues related to the conflict, including demands for a ceasefire, an end to the Israeli blockade and occupation, return of Israeli hostages, protesting war crimes, ending US support for Israel and providing humanitarian aid to Gaza.

events.title: 2023 Australian Indigenous Voice referendum
events.summary: The 2023 Australian Indigenous Voice referendum was a constitutional referendum held on 14 October 2023 in which the proposed Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Voice was rejected.

events.title: 2023 Polish referendum
events.summary: A referendum was held in Poland on 15 October 2023, taking place alongside the nationwide elections to the Senate and Sejm.

events.title: 2023 Polish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 15 October 2023 to elect members of the Sejm and Senate. A referendum containing four questions concerning economic and immigration policy of the government was held simultaneously.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Israel vs Hezbollah (Southern Lebanon)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Israel and Hezbollah over control of Southern Lebanon, starting 2023-10-18. This episode was active in 3 years (2023–2025), 1 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Ninth Extraordinary Session of the Islamic Summit Conference
events.summary: The Ninth Extraordinary Session of the Islamic Summit Conference was organized by the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) in response to the Gaza war. The meeting occurred on 18 October 2023 at the General Secretariat headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

events.title: 2023 Swiss federal election
events.summary: Federal elections were held in Switzerland on 22 October 2023 to elect all members of the National Council and Council of States. The elections were followed by elections to the Federal Council, Switzerland's government and collegial presidency, on 13 December.

events.title: 2023 Unitary Platform presidential primaries
events.summary: The 2023 Unitary Platform presidential primaries were primary elections held on 22 October 2023, to choose the opposition candidate of the Unitary Platform coalition in the elections of the following year for the presidency of Venezuela.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council. Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: European Council meeting (euro summit)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (euro summit meeting). Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: 2023 antisemitic riots in the North Caucasus
events.summary: Towards the end of October 2023, several violent antisemitic riots occurred in the North Caucasus region of Russia. The riots occurred during the Gaza war, a conflict which caused an increase in antisemitic incidents in various parts of the world.

events.title: AI Safety Summit 2023
events.summary: The AI Safety Summit 2023 was an international conference on the safety and regulation of artificial intelligence. Organized by the British government, it was held in November 2023 at Bletchley Park, Milton Keynes, England.

events.title: 2023 Organization of Turkic States summit
events.summary: The 2023 Organization of Turkic States summit, officially the 10th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Organization of Turkic States summit, was a meeting between the leaders of the Organization of Turkic States in Astana, Kazakhstan, on 3 November 2023.

events.title: Earthquake: 2023 Nepal earthquake
events.summary: A moment magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck Jajarkot, Karnali Province, Nepal, at 23:47 NPT on 3 November 2023, killing 153 people and injuring at least 375. The earthquake was widely felt in western Nepal and northern India, and is the deadliest to strike the country since 2015.

events.title: 38th Republican People's Party Ordinary Convention
events.summary: The 38th Republican People's Party Ordinary Convention, also called the Democracy and Unity Convention was held on 4–5 November 2023 in Ankara Arena. During the convention, the leader and congress of the Republican People's Party (CHP), the centre-left main opposition party in Turkey, was elected.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Syria vs SDF (Rojava Kurdistan)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Syria and SDF over territory and government, starting 2023-11-06. This episode was active in 3 years (2023–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2023 Arab–Islamic extraordinary summit
events.summary: The 2023 Arab–Islamic extraordinary summit was organized between the Arab League and the Organization of Islamic Cooperation on 11 November 2023, in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman. The urgent meeting was prompted by the Gaza war.

events.title: APEC United States 2023
events.summary: APEC 2023 United States was the year-long hosting of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meetings in the United States taking place in 2023. It was held in San Francisco. APEC United States 2023 marked the third time the United States hosted an APEC meeting, having previously hosted in 1993 in Blake Island and 2011 in Honolulu.

events.title: Luc Frieden takes power
events.summary: Luc Frieden is a Luxembourgish politician and lawyer serving as prime minister of Luxembourg since November 2023. A member of the Christian Social People's Party (CSV), he held numerous cabinet positions in the Luxembourgish government between 1998 and 2013, notably serving as the minister for the Treasury and Budget during the transition from the Franc to…

events.title: 2025 Marshallese constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in the Marshall Islands on 25 April 2025. Citizens voted on amendments to the constitution proposed by parliament and approved by the constitutional convention elected in 2017. Originally scheduled to be held concurrently with the 2023 Marshallese general election, it was delayed to 2025.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Myanmar vs MNDAA (Kokang)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Myanmar (Burma) and MNDAA over control of Kokang, starting 2023-11-22. This episode was active in 2 years (2023–2024), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2024-10-14.

events.title: 2023 Dutch general election
events.summary: Early general elections were held in the Netherlands on 22 November 2023 to elect the members of the House of Representatives. The elections had been expected to be held in 2025, but a snap election was called after the fourth Rutte cabinet collapsed on 7 July 2023 due to disagreements on immigration policy between the coalition parties.

events.title: 2023 Dublin riot
events.summary: On the evening of 23 November 2023, a riot took place in Dublin, Ireland, which involved multiple incidents of vandalism, arson, and looting in the city centre as well as assaults on Gardaí and members of the public. Gardaí described the riot as the most violent in modern Dublin history, far surpassing the 2006 riots.

events.title: 2023 Gaza war ceasefire
events.summary: A temporary ceasefire between Israel and Hamas-led Palestinian militant groups in the Gaza Strip took effect from 24 November 2023 to 30 November 2023, during the Gaza war.

events.title: 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference
events.summary: The 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference or Conference of the Parties of the UNFCCC, more commonly known as COP28, was the 28th United Nations Climate Change conference, held from 30 November to 13 December at Expo City Dubai. The COP conference has been held annually since the first UN climate agreement in 1992.

events.title: Assassination: 2023 Paris attack
events.summary: On 2 December 2023, a French man carried out a machete and hammer attack against three people near the Pont de Bir-Hakeim in Paris, France, killing one of them. The suspect was allegedly motivated by Islamic extremism.

events.title: 2023 Venezuelan referendum
events.summary: A consultative referendum was initiated by the government of Nicolás Maduro regarding Venezuela's claim over the Essequibo region, referred to by Venezuela as Guayana Esequiba, a territory disputed with, and controlled by, neighboring Guyana. The referendum took place on 3 December 2023 in Venezuela.

events.title: Robert Jenrick resigns as Minister of State for Immigration
events.summary: Robert Jenrick resigned as Minister of State for Immigration on 6 December 2023, having held the office since 25 October 2022.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Central African Republic vs MPC (Logone)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Central African Republic (backed by Government of Bangladesh, Government of Benin, Government of Bhutan, Government of Brazil, Government of Burkina Faso, Government of Burundi, Government of Cambodia (Kampuchea), Government of Cameroon, Government of China, Government of Congo, Government of Djibouti, Government of Egypt, Government of Gambia, Government of Ghana, Government of Guinea, Government of Indonesia, Government of Ivory Coast, Government of Jordan, Government of Mali, Government of Mauritania, Government of Morocco, Government of Nepal, Government of Niger, Government of Nigeria, Government of Pakistan, Government of Peru, Government of Portugal, Government of Romania, Government of Rwanda, Government of Senegal, Government of Serbia (Yugoslavia), Government of Spain, Government of Sri Lanka, Government of Sweden, Government of Tanzania, Government of Togo, Government of Tunisia, Government of Turkey, Government of Zambia) and MPC over control of Logone, starting 2023-12-09. This episode was active in 1 year (2023–2023), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2023-12-09.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Spain.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Iran vs Jaish al-Adl
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Iran and Jaish al-Adl over control of the government, starting 2023-12-15. This episode was active in 3 years (2023–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2023 Chadian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum in Chad was held on 17 December 2023 on a new constitution formulated following the death of President Idriss Déby in 2021. The draft had been approved by the National Transitional Council on 27 June 2023.

events.title: 2023 Chilean constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Chile on 17 December 2023, to determine whether the public approved a new constitution drafted by an appointed committee of experts and amended by an elected Constitutional Council. The new text of the constitution was approved by the Council on 30 October and put to a vote on 17 December.

events.title: 2023 Serbian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 17 December 2023 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were originally due by 30 April 2026; Aleksandar Vučić, the president of Serbia, dissolved the National Assembly and called a snap election on 1 November 2023, on the proposal of the government.

events.title: Earthquake: 2023 Jishishan earthquake
events.summary: On 18 December 2023 at around 23:59:30 CST, an earthquake with a magnitude of 5.9–6.2 struck Jishishan County, in Gansu Province, China. The shallow thrust faulting earthquake struck a densely populated area on the border between the provinces of Gansu and Qinghai. It caused 151 deaths and 982 injuries to others.

events.title: South Africa's genocide case against Israel
events.summary: The Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip is an ongoing case that was brought before the International Court of Justice on 29 December 2023 by South Africa regarding Israel's conduct in the Gaza Strip during the Gaza war, that resulted in a humanitarian crisis and mass killings.

events.title: Earthquake: 2024 Noto earthquake
events.summary: On 1 January 2024, at 16:10:09 JST, a MJMA7.6 earthquake struck 6 km (3.7 mi) north-northeast of Suzu, located on the Noto Peninsula of Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. The reverse-faulting shock achieved a maximum JMA seismic intensity of Shindo 7 and Modified Mercalli intensity of X–XI (Extreme).

events.title: Dick Schoof takes power
events.summary: Hendrikus Wilhelmus Maria "Dick" Schoof is a Dutch politician and civil servant who served as the prime minister of the Netherlands from July 2024 to February 2026, leading the Schoof cabinet.

events.title: Assassination of Saleh al-Arouri
events.summary: On 2 January 2024, Saleh al-Arouri, the deputy leader of Hamas, was killed in an Israeli strike on an office in the Dahieh suburbs of Beirut, Lebanon. The strike also killed six other individuals, including additional high-ranking Hamas militants.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2024 Kerman bombings
events.summary: On 3 January 2024, a commemorative ceremony marking the assassination of Qasem Soleimani at his grave in eastern Kerman, Iran, was attacked by two bomb explosions. The attacks killed at least 95 people, and injured 284 others.

events.title: Margrethe II resigns as Monarch of Denmark
events.summary: Margrethe II resigned as Monarch of Denmark on 14 January 2024, having held the office since 14 January 1972.

events.title: Inauguration of Bernardo Arévalo
events.summary: Bernardo Arévalo was inaugurated as the president of Guatemala on 15 January 2024, marking the commencement of the four-year term of Arévalo as president and Karin Herrera as vice president.

events.title: 2024 Republican Party presidential primaries
events.summary: Presidential primaries and caucuses of the Republican Party took place within 49 U.S. states, Washington, D.C., and five U.S. territories between January 15, 2024, and June 4, 2024. These elections selected most of the 2,429 delegates to be sent to the Republican National Convention.

events.title: 2024 Iowa Republican presidential caucuses
events.summary: The 2024 Iowa Republican presidential caucuses were held on January 15, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 40 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional basis.

events.title: 2020s French farmers' protests
events.summary: The 2020s French farmers' protests are a series of protests and road blockages organized non unionized farmers and agricultural unions since 18 January 2024. The farmers protested against low food prices, proposed reductions in state subsidies for farmers' diesel fuel, and a EU-Mercosur free trade agreement.

events.title: 2024 Bashkortostan protests
events.summary: The 2024 Bashkortostan protests are a series of protests started on 15 January 2024 beginning in the Republic of Bashkortostan, Russia, sparked by the authorities initiating a criminal case against the Bashkir environmental activist Fail Alsynov, who was subsequently sentenced to four years in prison.

events.title: 2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries
events.summary: From January 23 to June 8, 2024, presidential primaries and caucuses were organized by the Democratic Party to select delegates to determine the party's nominee for president in the 2024 United States presidential election. The elections took place in all U.S. states except Florida and Delaware, in the District of Columbia, in five U.S.

events.title: 2024 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary was held on January 23, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election.

events.title: 2024 Italy–Africa Summit
events.summary: The 2024 Italy–Africa Summit took place in Rome on January 28–29. Hosted by the government of Italy, the summit was attended by representatives of forty-five African countries as well as the African Union.

events.title: Talat Xhaferi takes power
events.summary: Talat Xhaferi is a Macedonian politician who served as Prime Minister of North Macedonia from January to June 2024. He previously served as the President of the Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia from 2017 to 2024 and as Minister of Defense from 2013 to 2014.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: United Kingdom, United States of America – Yemen (Red Sea, Bab al Mandab and Gulf of Aden)
events.summary: UCDP records an interstate conflict between Government of United Kingdom, Government of United States of America (backed by Government of Australia, Government of Bahrain, Government of Canada, Government of Netherlands, Government of New Zealand, Government of Norway, Government of Singapore, Government of Sri Lanka) and Government of Yemen (North Yemen) over control of Red Sea, Bab al Mandab and Gulf of Aden, starting 2024-02-03. This episode was active in 2 years (2024–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2024 Salvadoran presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 4 February 2024. Voters elected the country's president and vice president to serve a five-year term. El Salvador used a two-round system, and if no candidate reached an absolute majority, a second round would have occurred on 3 March 2024.

events.title: 2024 Salvadoran legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in El Salvador in February and March 2024. In the first round on 4 February, voters elected all 60 deputies of the Legislative Assembly.

events.title: 2024 Azerbaijani presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Azerbaijan on 7 February 2024. Incumbent president Ilham Aliyev, who has held office since 2003, won a fifth consecutive term with over 92% of the vote, defeating his closest runner-up Zahid Oruj, who obtained just 2% of the vote.

events.title: Irakli Kobakhidze takes power
events.summary: Irakli Kobakhidze is a Georgian politician who holds the position of the prime minister of Georgia since 2024 and chairman of Georgian Dream since 2025, having previously served in this role from 2021 to 2024.

events.title: 2024 Nevada Republican presidential nominating contests
events.summary: The 2024 Nevada Republican presidential primary and caucus were held on February 6 and 8, 2024, respectively, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 26 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional basis in the caucus.

events.title: 2024 Finnish presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 28 January 2024, with a second round held on 11 February. Voters elected a president of the Republic for a six-year term.

events.title: Assassination: Death and funeral of Alexei Navalny
events.summary: On 16 February 2024, at 14:19 Moscow time, the Russian Federal Penitentiary Service (FSIN) of the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug announced that Russian opposition activist and political prisoner Alexei Navalny died while serving a 19-year prison sentence in FKU IK-3, a corrective colony in the village of Kharp in the Russian Arctic.

events.title: 2024 South Carolina Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 South Carolina Republican presidential primary was held on February 24, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 50 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a selection basis.

events.title: 2024 Belarusian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Belarus on 25 February 2024. The country elected 110 deputies to the lower house of parliament and 12,514 representatives of local councils.

events.title: 2024 Hungarian presidential election
events.summary: An early indirect presidential election was held in Hungary on 26 February 2024, following the resignation of Katalin Novák. Incumbent President of the Constitutional Court Tamás Sulyok was elected with a two-thirds majority.

events.title: Katalin Novák resigns as President of Hungary
events.summary: Katalin Novák resigned as President of Hungary on 26 February 2024, having held the office since 10 May 2022.

events.title: 2024 District of Columbia Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 District of Columbia Republican presidential primary was held from March 1 to 3, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 19 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-all basis.

events.title: 2024 Michigan Republican presidential nominating contests
events.summary: The 2024 Michigan Republican presidential primary and caucuses were held on February 27 and on March 2, 2024, respectively, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 55 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a proportional and winner-take-most basis.

events.title: 2024 California Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 California Republican presidential primary was held on March 5, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 169 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held on Super Tuesday alongside primaries in 14 other states.

events.title: 2024 Texas Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 Texas Republican presidential primary was held on March 5, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 161 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held on Super Tuesday alongside primaries in 14 other states.

events.title: 2024 Colorado Republican presidential primary
events.summary: The 2024 Colorado Republican presidential primary was held on March 5, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 37 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-take-most basis. The contest was held on Super Tuesday alongside primaries in 14 other states. Donald J.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Haiti vs Viv Ansanm
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Haiti (backed by Government of Bahamas, Government of Belize, Government of El Salvador, Government of Guatemala, Government of Jamaica, Government of Kenya) and Viv Ansanm over control of the government, starting 2024-03-06. This episode was active in 2 years (2024–2025), 1 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: March 2024 United Kingdom budget
events.summary: The March 2024 United Kingdom budget was delivered to the House of Commons by Jeremy Hunt, the Chancellor of the Exchequer, on 6 March 2024.

events.title: 2024 Portuguese legislative election
events.summary: A snap legislative election was held on 10 March 2024 to elect members of the Assembly of the Republic to the 16th Legislature of Portugal. All 230 seats to the Assembly of the Republic were up for election.

events.title: Noon Against Putin
events.summary: "Noon Against Putin" was a peaceful protest on 17 March of the 2024 Russian presidential election, where voters who do not support Vladimir Putin came en masse to polling stations at noon and vote against Putin or spoil the ballot.

events.title: Presidential election
events.summary: Putin re-elected with ~87% (official). Political Atlas, checked 25 October 2026.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council. Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: European Council meeting (euro summit)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (euro summit meeting). Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Crocus City Hall attack
events.summary: On 22 March 2024, a coordinated terrorist attack against civilians occurred at the Crocus City Hall music venue in Crocus City, Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast, Russia. The attack began at around 20:00 MSK (UTC+3), shortly before the Russian band Picnic was scheduled to play a sold-out show at the venue.

events.title: 2024 Maltese presidential election
events.summary: The 2024 Maltese presidential election took place on 27 March 2024. Members of the Parliament of Malta voted in an indirect election to elect the next President of Malta with former parliament speaker Myriam Spiteri Debono being the only nominee.

events.title: Assassination: Israeli airstrike on the Iranian consulate in Damascus
events.summary: On 1 April 2024, Israel conducted an airstrike on the Iranian embassy complex in Damascus, Syria, destroying the building housing its consular section. The airstrike began the 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, and took place during a period of heightened tension between Israel and Iran, and amidst the Gaza war and the Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

events.title: António Costa resigns as Prime Minister of Portugal
events.summary: António Costa resigned as Prime Minister of Portugal on 2 April 2024, having held the office since 26 November 2015.

events.title: Earthquake: 2024 Hualien earthquake
events.summary: On 3 April 2024, at 07:58:11 NST, a Mw 7.4 earthquake struck 15 km (9.3 mi) south of Hualien City, Hualien County, Taiwan. At least 19 people were killed and over 1,100 were injured in the earthquake. It was the strongest earthquake in Taiwan since the 1999 Jiji earthquake, with three aftershocks above Mw 6.0.

events.title: 2024 Slovak presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia in March and April 2024. Incumbent president Zuzana Čaputová announced in June 2023 that she would not run for a second term.

events.title: Dimitar Glavchev takes power
events.summary: Dimitar Borisov Glavchev is a Bulgarian politician who served as Prime Minister of Bulgaria from 2024 to 2025, leading a caretaker government. A political independent, he is currently the chairman of the Chamber of Audit. He was previously a member of the GERB party and served as member of the National Assembly from 2009 to 2021.

events.title: Bjarni Benediktsson takes power
events.summary: Bjarni Benediktsson, known colloquially as Bjarni Ben, is an Icelandic former politician who served as the prime minister of Iceland from January to November 2017 and again from April to December 2024.

events.title: Simon Harris takes power
events.summary: Simon Harris is an Irish Fine Gael politician serving as Tánaiste and Minister for Finance since 2025, having previously served as Taoiseach from 2024 to 2025, Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade and Minister for Defence from January to November 2025. He has been leader of Fine Gael since 2024 and a TD for the Wicklow constituency since 2011.

events.title: Verein KlimaSeniorinnen Schweiz v. Switzerland
events.summary: Verein KlimaSeniorinnen Schweiz v. Switzerland (2024) is a landmark European Court of Human Rights case in which the court ruled that Switzerland violated the European Convention on Human Rights by failing to adequately address climate change.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Bondi Junction stabbings
events.summary: On 13 April 2024, a mass stabbing occurred at the Westfield Bondi Junction shopping centre in the eastern suburbs of Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

events.title: 2024 Croatian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Croatia on 17 April 2024 to elect the members of the eleventh Sabor. Prior to the elections, the government consisted of a coalition of the Croatian Democratic Union and Independent Democratic Serb Party, with parliamentary support of five national minority MPs, two MPs from the Croatian Social Liberal Party and Croatian…

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: 2024 Ecuadorian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Ecuador on 21 April 2024, amid the 2024 Ecuadorian conflict.

events.title: 2024 North Kosovo referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the dismissal of four ethnic Albanian mayors of municipalities in Kosovo was held on 21 April 2024, in the region of North Kosovo with a majority Serb population. The municipalities where referendums for the replacement of mayors was held were: Zubin Potok, Zvečan, Leposavić, and North Mitrovica.

events.title: 2024 North Macedonian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in North Macedonia on 24 April 2024. Incumbent Stevo Pendarovski of the ruling centre-left Social Democrats ran for re-election to a second term.

events.title: Transitional Presidential Council takes power
events.summary: The Transitional Presidential Council was a temporary body constituted by the Council of Ministers on 12 April 2024 and sworn in at the National Palace on 25 April to exercise the powers and duties of the president of Haiti either until an elected president is inaugurated or until 7 February 2026, whichever came first.

events.title: 2024 Lithuanian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2024, alongside a referendum on allowing multiple citizenships. Incumbent President Gitanas Nausėda won re-election to a second term.

events.title: 2024 Panamanian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Panama on 5 May 2024 to elect a new president, members of the National Assembly and local governments. Due to constitutional term limits, incumbent president Laurentino Cortizo was ineligible for a second consecutive term. The winners of the general election, including the new president of Panama, were inaugurated on 1 July.

events.title: Fifth inauguration of Vladimir Putin
events.summary: The fifth inauguration of Vladimir Putin as President of Russia took place on Tuesday, 7 May 2024, after Putin was declared the winner of the 2024 Russian presidential election.

events.title: Humza Yousaf resigns as First Minister of Scotland
events.summary: Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland on 7 May 2024, having held the office since 29 March 2023.

events.title: 2024 North Macedonian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in North Macedonia on 8 May 2024. The slow pace of EU integration and corruption were the main issues during the campaign.

events.title: 2024 Lithuanian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Lithuania on 12 May 2024, alongside the first round of the presidential elections. Voters were asked whether they approve of a constitutional amendment to allow Lithuanian citizens to hold dual citizenship. The results showed that a majority of voters were in favour of the proposal.

events.title: 2024 visit by Vladimir Putin to China
events.summary: Russian president Vladimir Putin paid an official visit to China in May 2024. The visit was his first foreign visit after assuming office for the fifth term. The visit underscored the deepening partnership between Russia and China. The visit also coincided with the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Russia.

events.title: Coup: 2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt
events.summary: On 19 May 2024, an attempted coup d'état took place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Targeting President Félix Tshisekedi and his Economy Minister Vital Kamerhe, the assailants attacked both the Palais de la Nation and Kamerhe's residence. They were heavily armed and put up an intense fight at the Kamerhe home.

events.title: Inauguration of Lai Ching-te
events.summary: The inauguration of Lai Ching-te as the 14th president of the Republic of China took place on May 20, 2024, marking the start of the four-year term of Lai Ching-te as president and Hsiao Bi-khim as vice president, and the first time a political party started a third term since the implementation of direct elections in 1994.

events.title: AI Seoul Summit 2024
events.summary: The AI Seoul Summit 2024 was an event in May 2024 co-hosted by the South Korean and British governments. The Seoul Declaration was adopted to address artificial intelligence technology and related challenges and opportunities.

events.title: 2024 Libertarian National Convention
events.summary: The 2024 Libertarian National Convention was a political event to select the Libertarian Party nominees for president and vice president in the 2024 election. It was held from May 24 to the early morning of May 27, 2024, at the Washington Hilton in Washington, D.C.

events.title: 2024 Vanuatuan constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Vanuatu on 29 May 2024, the first time a referendum has been held in the country. Voters were asked whether they approve of two proposed amendments to the constitution aimed at reducing instability within Parliament.

events.title: 2024 Dominican Republic general election
events.summary: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 19 May 2024 to elect a president, vice-president, 32 senators, 190 deputies and 20 PARLACEN deputies.

events.title: 2024 Icelandic presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Iceland on 1 June 2024. Incumbent president Guðni Th. Jóhannesson announced that he would not seek a third term. Entrepreneur Halla Tómasdóttir was elected as his successor, and took office on 1 August.

events.title: General election
events.summary: Political Atlas, checked 25 October 2026.

events.title: 2024 Green Party presidential primaries
events.summary: The 2024 Green Party presidential primaries and caucuses were a series of electoral contests to elect delegates to the 2024 Green National Convention to choose the Green Party's presidential nominee in the 2024 presidential election. The convention was held as a virtual event from August 15 to 18, 2024.

events.title: 2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement
events.summary: The 2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement was a series of anti-government and pro-democracy protests in Bangladesh, spearheaded primarily by university students.

events.title: 2024 Belgian federal election
events.summary: Federal elections were held in Belgium on 9 June 2024. The Chamber of Representatives received 150 members with five-year terms. European and regional elections took place on the same day.

events.title: June 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in Bulgaria on 9 June 2024, to elect members of the National Assembly. The election coincided with the European Parliament election on the same day.

events.title: 2024 San Marino general election
events.summary: General elections were held in San Marino on 9 June 2024.

events.title: 2024 Slovenian referendum
events.summary: A four-question non-binding referendum was held in Slovenia on 9 June 2024. The questions were:Should Slovenia allow the cultivation and processing of cannabis for medical purposes on its territory? Should Slovenia allow the cultivation and possession of cannabis for limited personal use on its territory? Are you in favor of adopting a law that will…

events.title: 50th G7 summit
events.summary: The 50th G7 summit was held from 13 to 15 June 2024 in the city of Fasano in Apulia, Italy.

events.title: June 2024 Ukraine peace summit
events.summary: An international peace summit in relation to the Russo-Ukrainian War, formally called the Summit on Peace in Ukraine, was held in Bürgenstock Resort in Switzerland on 15–16 June 2024. The conference followed a series of four earlier international meetings, and was hosted by the Swiss president Viola Amherd.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Belgium.

events.title: Kenya Finance Bill protests
events.summary: A series of decentralized mass protests took place in Kenya in response to tax increases proposed by the Government of Kenya in the Finance Bill 2024.

events.title: 2024 visit by Vladimir Putin to North Korea
events.summary: On June 19, 2024, Vladimir Putin, the president of Russia, visited North Korea. This was Putin's first official visit to North Korea since 2000, and came after North Korea–Russia relations improved significantly following the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

events.title: Sara Duterte resigns as Secretary of Education
events.summary: Sara Duterte resigned as Secretary of Education on 19 June 2024, having held the office since 30 June 2022.

events.title: Hristijan Mickoski takes power
events.summary: Hristijan Mickoski is a Macedonian mechanical engineer, professor, and government official serving as Prime Minister of North Macedonia, a position he has held since June 2024. He is the party leader of VMRO-DPMNE.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Russia vs IS (Islamic State)
