Robust security guarantees for Ukraine akin to Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty were the primary topic on the agenda.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Denmark.

events.title: 2025 Taiwanese referendum
events.summary: A national referendum was held on 23 August 2025 in Taiwan. Backed by the Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP), the Legislative Yuan considered four referendum proposals. Only one proposal, on whether to reverse the decommissioning of the Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant's second reactor, was approved by the Central Election Commission.

events.title: August 2025 Indonesian protests
events.summary: On 25 August until early September 2025, several protests took place in Indonesia as part of a larger civil unrest which began in early 2025 over economic frustrations and a proposed hike in housing subsidies for members of parliament.

events.title: 2025 Egyptian Senate election (second round)
events.summary: Senate elections were held in Egypt between 4 and 5 August 2025, with Egyptian expatriates voting between 1 and 2 August. Run-offs took place from 27–28 August. Results were announced by the National Elections Authority (NEA) on 12 August 2025.

events.title: Assassination: August 2025 Israeli attack on Sanaa
events.summary: On 28 August 2025, the Israeli Air Force (IAF) conducted targeted strikes, codenamed Operation Lucky Drop against several Houthi ministers in Bayt Baws, Sanaa, Yemen.

events.title: 2025 Samoan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Samoa on 29 August 2025 to determine the composition of the 18th Parliament. Initially expected to be held in 2026, Prime Minister Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa called a snap election after parliament voted down the government budget on 27 May 2025.

events.title: 2025 Global Sumud Flotilla
events.summary: The Global Sumud Flotilla, sometimes referred to as the Global Freedom Flotilla, was an international, civil society-led maritime initiative launched in mid-2025, which attempted to break the Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip but was thwarted in an intercept by Israeli naval forces. It is named after ṣumūd, Arabic for 'steadfastness' or 'resilience'.

events.title: Assassination of Andriy Parubiy
events.summary: Andriy Parubiy, a Ukrainian politician, was shot dead in Lviv, Ukraine, on 30 August 2025 at age 54. The attack occurred at around 10:35 am EEST on Yefremov Street. A suspect had been arrested in Khmelnytskyi Oblast by 1 September.

events.title: Earthquake: 2025 Kunar earthquake
events.summary: On 31 August 2025, at 23:47 AFT, an earthquake with a magnitude of 6.0 on the moment magnitude scale (Mw) struck eastern Afghanistan, near the border with Pakistan. The epicenter of the quake was located in Nurgal District, Kunar Province.

events.title: 2025 Tianjin SCO summit
events.summary: The SCO Tianjin Summit 2025 was the 25th Heads of State Council meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), which was held from 31 August to 1 September 2025, in Tianjin, China. It was the largest summit in SCO's history, and was the fifth time that China hosted the meeting.

events.title: 2025 Guyanese general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Guyana on 1 September 2025. The result was a victory for President Irfaan Ali and the governing People's Progressive Party/Civic, who won 36 seats, an increase of three from the 2020 election. The declaration of the result was made by GECOM on 7 September 2025 at midnight, and Ali was inaugurated later that day.

events.title: 2025 Jamaican general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Jamaica on 3 September 2025. The incumbent Jamaica Labour Party (JLP) government, led by Prime Minister Andrew Holness, won a third term in office against the opposition People's National Party (PNP). However, the JLP lost 14 seats to the PNP, still retaining a majority.

events.title: 2025–2026 Philippine anti-corruption protests
events.summary: On September 4, 2025, a series of widespread demonstrations began in the Philippines, with the largest initial protests occurring on September 11 at Rizal Park and Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila, and at the People Power Monument, Camp Aguinaldo Gate 4, and EDSA Shrine along EDSA in Quezon City, both within Metro Manila.

events.title: Angela Rayner resigns as Deputy Leader of the Labour Party
events.summary: Angela Rayner resigned as Deputy Leader of the Labour Party on 5 September 2025, having held the office since 4 April 2020.

events.title: 2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests
events.summary: In September 2025, large-scale anti-corruption protests and demonstrations took place all across Nepal, predominantly organized by Generation Z students and young citizens.

events.title: 2025 Norwegian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 8 September 2025 to elect all 169 members of the Storting, the Norwegian parliament, for the 2025–2029 parliamentary term. Advance voting took place from 11 August to 5 September.

events.title: Battle: 2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland
events.summary: On 9 September 2025, at about 11:30 p.m. CEST, over 30 unarmed military drones entered Poland's airspace after allegedly being launched from Russia. The incursion triggered a Quick Reaction Alert; the Polish Air Force and other NATO militaries scrambled aircraft. Up to four drones were confirmed to have been shot down, most by the Dutch Air Force.

events.title: Assassination of Charlie Kirk
events.summary: On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk, an American right-wing political activist, was assassinated at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah, while speaking at an outdoor campus debate planned by Turning Point USA, the conservative youth organization he co-founded and led.

events.title: 2025 Timor-Leste protests
events.summary: In September 2025, student-led protests were held in Dili, the capital of Timor-Leste, against the National Parliament's decision to purchase SUVs for legislators at a cost of US$4 million. The demonstrators' demands soon expanded to calling for the cancellation of lifetime pensions for former MPs.

events.title: 2025 Malawian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Malawi on 16 September 2025 to elect the president, the 229 members of the National Assembly and 509 local government councillors.

events.title: 2025 state visit by Donald Trump to the United Kingdom
events.summary: From 16 to 18 September 2025, the president of the United States, Donald Trump, made a state visit to the United Kingdom with his wife, the first lady of the United States, Melania Trump.

events.title: Treaty signed: Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement
events.summary: The Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement (SMDA) is a security and defence pact between the countries of Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. Under this agreement both countries have committed to treating any act of aggression against one as an act against both known as collective security.

events.title: 2025 Italian general strikes and protests for Gaza
events.summary: On 22 September 2025, a 24-hour general strike called by grassroots unions Unione Sindacale di Base (USB), Confederazione Unitaria di Base (CUB), Sindacato Generale di Base (SGB), Associazione Difesa Lavoratrici e Lavoratori (ADL) and Italian Syndicalist Union (USI) was held across Italy to protest the country's complicity in the Gaza war, and saw the…

events.title: 2025 Maldivian protests
events.summary: The 2025 Maldivian protests were protests in the Maldives from September until November against perceived government corruption and democratic backsliding as part of the wider Gen Z protests.

events.title: 2025 Guinean constitutional referendum
events.summary: A referendum on a new constitution was held in Guinea on 21 September 2025, to determine whether to replace the existing constitution introduced in 2020 with a new version that introduced a Senate and extended the term limits for the president. Voters approved the new constitution by 89% to 11%.

events.title: Inga Ruginienė takes power
events.summary: Inga Ruginienė is a Lithuanian trade unionist and politician serving as Minister of Social Security and Labour since 2026. Previously she served as the 19th Prime Minister of Lithuania from 25 September 2025 until 14 July 2026. A member of the Social Democratic Party of Lithuania, she has been a Member of the Seimas since 2024.

events.title: 2025 Malagasy protests
events.summary: The 2025 Malagasy protests were decentralized, Gen Z–led protests across Madagascar from September to October 2025, culminating in a coup d'état by the CAPSAT unit, which overthrew sitting President Andry Rajoelina and led to the establishment of the Council of the Presidency for the Re-Foundation of the Republic.

events.title: 2025 Seychellois general election (first round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Seychelles on 27 September 2025 to elect a president and members of the National Assembly, with a second round of the presidential election held from 9 to 11 October after no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round.

events.title: 2025 Gabonese parliamentary election (first round)
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Gabon on 27 September 2025 alongside municipal elections, with a second round held on 11 October in constituencies where no candidate received a majority. A third round took place on 18 October in eight constituencies.

events.title: 2025 Moroccan Gen Z protests
events.summary: A series of youth-led demonstrations took place in Morocco between 27 September and 18 October 2025. Organized by decentralized, anonymous collectives known as GenZ 212 and Moroccan Youth Voice, the protests demanded significant improvements to public education and healthcare, while criticizing government focus on international sporting events like the 2030…

events.title: 2025 Peruvian protests
events.summary: On 20 September 2025, protests began in Peru against the administration of Dina Boluarte and the subsequent administration of José Jerí, following the impeachment of Dina Boluarte and the Congress of Peru. Protests against President Jerí grew following allegations of sexual assault against him.

events.title: 2025 Moldovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Moldova on 28 September 2025. Moldova is a parliamentary republic; the Parliament of Moldova has the main authority of creating laws and appointing the government, and executive powers are primarily derived from the legislature.

events.title: 2025 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2025, with national votes on 9 February, 28 September and 30 November.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Denmark.

events.title: 7th European Political Community Summit
events.summary: The Seventh European Political Community Summit was a meeting of the European Political Community held on 2 October 2025 in Copenhagen, Denmark.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2025 Manchester synagogue attack
events.summary: On 2 October 2025, during the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur, a man drove a black Kia Picanto into pedestrians before stabbing worshippers at the Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation, a synagogue in Higher Crumpsall, a northern suburb of the city of Manchester in North West England.

events.title: 2025 Czech parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in the Czech Republic on 3 and 4 October 2025, to elect all 200 members of the Chamber of Deputies, the lower house of the Czech Parliament.

events.title: 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election
events.summary: The 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election was held on 4 October 2025 to elect the next president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan (LDP).

events.title: 2025 Barbadian presidential election
events.summary: The 2025 Barbadian presidential election was held on 7 October 2025 to choose the second president of Barbados. Dame Sandra Mason, the inaugural president elected to replace Queen Elizabeth II as head of state of Barbados in 2021, completed her term on 29 November 2025, and chose to retire rather than run for a second term.

events.title: 2025 Seychellois general election (second round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Seychelles on 27 September 2025 to elect a president and members of the National Assembly, with a second round of the presidential election held from 9 to 11 October after no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round.

events.title: 2025 Gabonese parliamentary election (second round)
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Gabon on 27 September 2025 alongside municipal elections, with a second round held on 11 October in constituencies where no candidate received a majority. A third round took place on 18 October in eight constituencies.

events.title: 2025 Nauruan constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Nauru on 11 October 2025, the same day as the parliamentary election. The referendum was the result of a government proposal to amend the constitution to change the parliament term from three to four years. A two-thirds majority was required for the amendment to pass.

events.title: 2025 Nauruan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Nauru on 11 October 2025. It was held alongside a constitutional referendum.

events.title: 2025 New Zealand local referendums on Māori wards and constituencies
events.summary: The 2025 New Zealand local referendums on Māori wards and constituencies were referendums held from 9 September until 11 October 2025, on the question of whether to have dedicated Māori wards and constituencies on local councils in New Zealand. The referendums occurred alongside that year's nation-wide local elections.

events.title: 2025 Cameroonian protests
events.summary: In the aftermath of the 2025 Cameroonian presidential election, protests broke out amid allegations of election fraud.

events.title: 2025 Cameroonian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Cameroon on 12 October 2025.

events.title: Hamburger Zukunftsentscheid
events.summary: Two referendums were held on 12 October 2025 in the German city-state of Hamburg. The citizens of Hamburg were able to vote on two proposed laws that were initiated via popular initiative: "Law on the Implementation of a Basic Income Pilot Program in the State of Hamburg" by the initiative Hamburg testet Grundeinkommen and the "Law for better climate…

events.title: Hamburg testet Grundeinkommen
events.summary: Two referendums were held on 12 October 2025 in the German city-state of Hamburg. The citizens of Hamburg were able to vote on two proposed laws that were initiated via popular initiative: "Law on the Implementation of a Basic Income Pilot Program in the State of Hamburg" by the initiative Hamburg testet Grundeinkommen and the "Law for better climate…

events.title: Coup: 2025 Malagasy coup d'état
events.summary: On 12 October 2025, CAPSAT, an elite unit of the Madagascar Armed Forces, overthrew the government of President Andry Rajoelina, the culmination of a protest movement which began in late September. The unit urged the rest of the military to join them and the capital Antananarivo was seized with little resistance.

events.title: Gaza peace summit
events.summary: The Gaza peace summit, also known as the Sharm El-Sheikh Peace Summit, was a diplomatic meeting held on 13 October 2025 in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt, following an agreement to implement the first phase of the Gaza peace plan to end the Gaza war which began in 2023.

events.title: 2025 Kuomintang chairmanship election
events.summary: The 2025 Kuomintang chairmanship election was held on 18 October 2025. It was the eleventh direct election of the party leader in Kuomintang (KMT) history. All registered, due-paying KMT party members were eligible to vote.

events.title: October 2025 No Kings protests
events.summary: No Kings protests took place on October 18, 2025, as part of a series of demonstrations taking place largely in the United States against Donald Trump's policies and actions during his second presidency.

events.title: 2025 Bolivian general election (second round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Bolivia on 17 August 2025 to elect the president, vice president, and all members of the Plurinational Legislative Assembly. Incumbent president Luis Arce of the ruling Movimiento al Socialismo (MAS-IPSP) did not seek reelection, amid internal party divisions and widespread dissatisfaction over shortages of essential goods.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Melissa
events.summary: Hurricane Melissa was an extremely powerful tropical cyclone that made a catastrophic landfall in Jamaica in late October 2025. By maximum sustained winds, it is tied with Hurricane Allen as the strongest Atlantic hurricane, and with Hurricane Dorian and the 1935 Labor Day hurricane as the strongest landfalling Atlantic hurricane.

events.title: Sanae Takaichi takes power
events.summary: Sanae Takaichi is a Japanese politician who has been Prime Minister of Japan and President of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) since October 2025. She is the first woman to hold either of these positions in Japanese history.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Denmark.

events.title: 2025 Irish presidential election
events.summary: The 2025 Irish presidential election took place on Friday, 24 October 2025, to elect a new president of Ireland. The incumbent president, Michael D. Higgins, was term-limited, having served the maximum two seven-year terms permitted under the Constitution of Ireland.

events.title: 2025 Ivorian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Ivory Coast on 25 October 2025. Incumbent President Alassane Ouattara was re-elected with 91% of the vote.

events.title: 2025 Argentine legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Argentina on 26 October 2025. Nearly half of the seats in the Chamber of Deputies and a third of the seats in the Senate were contested.

events.title: 2025 ASEAN Summits
events.summary: The 2025 ASEAN Summits, also known as the 46th and 47th ASEAN Summits, were diplomatic conferences centering on the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) which were held in Malaysia from 26 to 27 May 2025 and 26 to 28 October 2025. This marks the fifth and sixth time the ASEAN Summit was held in Malaysia.

events.title: 2025 Dutch general election
events.summary: Early general elections were held in the Netherlands on 29 October 2025 to elect the members of the House of Representatives. The elections had been expected to be held in 2028, but a snap election was called after the Schoof cabinet collapsed due to the Party for Freedom (PVV) withdrawing from the coalition.

events.title: 2025 Tanzanian election protests
events.summary: A series of demonstrations and civil unrest began in Tanzania on 29 October 2025 amid the country's 2025 general election. The protests erupted in Dar es Salaam and later spread to other cities, following allegations of electoral irregularities, suppression of opposition parties, and police intimidation.

events.title: 2025 Tanzanian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Tanzania on 29 October 2025 to elect the President, members of the National Assembly and ward councillors. Samia Suluhu Hassan, the incumbent president and leader of the ruling Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM), who became president after the death of President John Magufuli in 2021, ran for a second term.

events.title: Busan Summit
events.summary: The Busan Summit was a summit meeting held on 30 October 2025, in Busan, South Korea, between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and United States President Donald Trump. This was the first face-to-face meeting between the two leaders in six years since the 2019 G20 Osaka summit.

events.title: APEC South Korea 2025
events.summary: The APEC South Korea 2025 was a year-long hosting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meetings, which concluded with the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting on November 1, 2025. It was the second time South Korea hosted the summit, having previously hosted in 2005.

events.title: 2025 Mexican protests
events.summary: In November and December 2025, a series of anti-government demonstrations was held across Mexico following the assassination of Uruapan mayor Carlos Manzo. The protests expressed dissatisfaction with the administration of President Claudia Sheinbaum, particularly over the federal response to drug-related violence and alleged official negligence.

events.title: 2025 California Proposition 50
events.summary: California Proposition 50, officially known as the Election Rigging Response Act, is an amendment to the constitution of the U.S. state of California, which was passed by voters in a special election ballot on November 4, 2025.

events.title: 2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference
events.summary: The 2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference or Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC, more commonly known as COP30, was the 30th session of the United Nations Climate Change Conference. It was held at the Hangar Convention Centre in Belém, Brazil, from 10 to 21 November 2025.

events.title: 2025 Egyptian parliamentary election (first round)
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt for 17 governorates from 10 to 11 November 2025, while the remainder of the governorates held elections from 24 to 25 November 2025, with first-phase runoffs held from 3–4 December. Second-phase runoffs were held from 17 to 18 December.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2025 Delhi Red Fort blast
events.summary: On 10 November 2025, a car exploded near the Red Fort in Delhi, India, killing at least 15 people and injuring more than 20 others. According to the Delhi Police, there were two to three people inside the car at the time of the explosion.

events.title: 2025 Iraqi parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Iraq on 11 November 2025. The elections determined the 329 members of Iraq's Council of Representatives, who are responsible for electing the country's president, who would then appoint the prime minister.

events.title: 2025 Chilean general election (first round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Chile on 16 November 2025. Voters went to the polls to elect the 38th president of Chile, renew all 155 seats in the Chamber of Deputies, and fill 23 of the 50 seats in the Senate. Republican Party candidate José Antonio Kast defeated Communist Party member Jeannette Jara in a runoff election on 14 December.

events.title: 2025–2026 Albanian opposition protests
events.summary: The 2025–2026 Albanian opposition protests were a series of anti-government civic actions in Albania, primarily in Tirana, against Prime Minister Edi Rama and the Rama government. The larger context for the protests was the allegations, levied by the opposition, of irregularities in the 2025 Albanian parliamentary election.

events.title: Paschal Donohoe resigns as Minister for Finance (Ireland)
events.summary: Paschal Donohoe resigned as Minister for Finance (Ireland) on 18 November 2025, having held the office since 23 January 2025.

events.title: 2025 Tongan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Tonga on 20 November 2025. Prominent campaign issues included the cost of living and the monarchy's influence in government.

events.title: 2025 G20 Johannesburg summit
events.summary: The 2025 G20 Johannesburg summit was the twentieth meeting of the Group of Twenty (G20), a Head of State and Government meeting held at the Johannesburg Expo Centre, Johannesburg, South Africa on 22–23 November 2025. It was the first G20 summit to take place on the African continent.

events.title: 2025 Guinea-Bissau general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Guinea-Bissau on 23 November 2025 to elect the president and members of the National People's Assembly. Separate parliamentary and presidential elections were planned.

events.title: 2025 Slovenian assisted dying referendum
events.summary: A binding referendum was held in Slovenia on 23 November 2025 regarding the Assisted Voluntary End of Life Act. The National Assembly passed the Act in July after voters had backed it in a nonbinding referendum in 2024. However, a citizens' initiative led by right-wing politician Aleš Primc forced a referendum on the act.

events.title: 7th European Union–African Union Summit
events.summary: The 7th African Union–European Union Summit was a meeting of heads of state and government from the member states of the African Union (AU) and the European Union (EU), held in Luanda, Angola, on 24–25 November 2025.

events.title: 2025 Egyptian parliamentary election (second round)
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt for 17 governorates from 10 to 11 November 2025, while the remainder of the governorates held elections from 24 to 25 November 2025, with first-phase runoffs held from 3–4 December. Second-phase runoffs were held from 17 to 18 December.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Denmark.

events.title: Coup: 2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état
events.summary: On 26 November 2025, the president of Guinea-Bissau, Umaro Sissoco Embaló, was arrested as part of a coup d'état carried out by Head of the Military Office of the Presidency Brigadier General Dinis Incanha.

events.title: 2025–2026 Bulgarian protests
events.summary: Protests began in Bulgaria on 26 November 2025 after the Zhelyazkov government announced a 2026 budget plan that would have increased taxes—specifically, the amounts individuals were to contribute to pension and social-security programs.

events.title: November 2025 United Kingdom budget
events.summary: The November 2025 United Kingdom budget was delivered to the House of Commons by Rachel Reeves, the Chancellor of the Exchequer, on 26 November 2025.

events.title: 2025 Vincentian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines on 27 November 2025 to elect 15 members of the House of Assembly.

events.title: 2025 visit by Pope Leo XIV to Turkey and Lebanon
events.summary: Pope Leo XIV visited Turkey from November 27 to 30, and Lebanon from November 30 to December 2, 2025. The trip was this pope's first apostolic journey abroad since his election in May 2025. The visit to Turkey included an ecumenical commemoration of the 1,700th anniversary of the First Council of Nicaea.

events.title: Andriy Yermak resigns as Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine
events.summary: Andriy Yermak resigned as Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine on 28 November 2025, having held the office since 11 February 2020.

events.title: 2025 Honduran general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Honduras on 30 November 2025. Voters elected the President, all 128 members of the National Congress, and 20 representatives to the Central American Parliament (PARLACEN). The National Electoral Council (CNE) declared National Party candidate Nasry Asfura as the election's winner on 24 December.

events.title: 2025 Kyrgyz parliamentary election
events.summary: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Kyrgyzstan on 30 November 2025 to elect members of the Supreme Council, following the self-dissolution of parliament in September 2025. The parliamentary elections were initially planned for November 2026 under the regular electoral calendar.

events.title: 2025 Peruvian Aprista Party presidential primary
events.summary: On 30 November 2025, members of the Peruvian Aprista Party chose a presidential ticket for the 2026 presidential election.

events.title: 2025 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2025, with national votes on 9 February, 28 September and 30 November.

events.title: 2025 Saint Lucian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Saint Lucia on 1 December 2025 to elect all 17 members of the House of Assembly. The centre-left incumbent Saint Lucia Labour Party won a landslide, increasing both its number of seats and share of the popular vote.

events.title: Roblox ban protests in Russia
events.summary: On 3 December 2025, the Russian federal communications regulator, Roskomnadzor, would state that they would implement a national ban in the Russian Federation on the U.S.-based online game platform & game creation system, Roblox.

events.title: Coup: 2025 Beninese coup attempt
events.summary: On 7 December 2025, several soldiers of the Benin Armed Forces (FAB) led by Lieutenant Colonel Pascal Tigri announced on national television the overthrow of Patrice Talon, the president of Benin, following an attack on Talon's residence in Cotonou and the residences of other top-ranking military officials.

events.title: Andrej Babiš takes power
events.summary: Andrej Babiš is a Czech politician and businessman who has been the prime minister of the Czech Republic since December 2025, having previously served as prime minister from 2017 to 2021. Prior to that, he was the minister of finance and deputy prime minister from 2014 to 2017.

events.title: 2025 Portuguese general strike
events.summary: The 2025 Portuguese general strike took place on 11 December against the policies of the Democratic Alliance government regarding the labor package. The demonstrations took place throughout the country, organized by the two main trade union federations, CGTP and UGT.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Bondi Beach shooting
events.summary: On 14 December 2025, an antisemitic and Islamic State (IS)–inspired terrorist attack occurred at the Archer Park area of Bondi Beach in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, during a celebration of the Jewish holiday of Hanukkah attended by around 1,000 people.

events.title: 2025 Chilean general election (second round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Chile on 16 November 2025. Voters went to the polls to elect the 38th president of Chile, renew all 155 seats in the Chamber of Deputies, and fill 23 of the 50 seats in the Senate. Republican Party candidate José Antonio Kast defeated Communist Party member Jeannette Jara in a runoff election on 14 December.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Denmark.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2025 Taipei stabbings
events.summary: On 19 December 2025, 27-year-old Chang Wen threw smoke grenades and stabbed people at two locations in Taipei, Taiwan, killing three people and injuring eleven others. Chang Wen fled from police and died when he fell from the Eslite Bookstore Nanxi building near Zhongshan Station.

events.title: Second Ayurveda World Summit, Bangalore
events.summary: The second edition of Ayurveda World Summit was held in Palace grounds, Bangalore, from 25 to 28 December 2025. It was organized by Kaje Ayurvedic Chartable Foundation, Ministry of Ayush.

events.title: 2025 Ivorian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Ivory Coast on 27 December 2025. The ruling Rally of Houphouëtists for Democracy and Peace won 197 of 255 seats in the National Assembly.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Yemen vs STC (South Yemen)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Yemen (North Yemen) and STC over control of South Yemen, starting 2025-12-27. This episode was active in 1 year (2025–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2025 Central African general election (first round)
events.summary: General elections were held in the Central African Republic (CAR) on 28 December 2025 to elect both the president and National Assembly. A second round of the legislative elections was held on 26 April 2026. The incumbent president, Faustin-Archange Touadéra, was seeking a third term following the removal of term limits in a constitutional referendum.

events.title: 2025 Guinean presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Guinea on 28 December 2025. They are the first to be held in the country since the 2021 Guinean coup d'état that installed general Mamady Doumbouya as president. Doumbouya won by a landslide margin amid criticism by opposition groups and the United Nations over the conduct of the election.

events.title: 2025–2026 Iranian protests
events.summary: The 2025–2026 Iranian protests were a series of nationwide demonstrations against the government of Iran that began on 28 December 2025 amid a deepening economic crisis. The unrest followed a sharp depreciation of the Iranian rial, rising inflation, and widespread shortages linked to international sanctions and government mismanagement.

events.title: December 2025 Kosovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Kosovo on 28 December 2025 to elect the 120 members of the Assembly. In the previous election in February 2025, no party had won a majority of seats, resulting in a hung parliament with Vetëvendosje, party of Prime Minister Albin Kurti, remaining the largest party.

events.title: 2025–26 Myanmar general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Myanmar for elected seats in the Amyotha Hluttaw and the Pyithu Hluttaw of the Pyidaungsu Hluttaw in three phases, beginning on 28 December 2025 and concluding on 25 January 2026. The election is being held by Myanmar's military junta that came to power after the 2021 military coup d'état.

events.title: Guy Parmelin is sworn in as President of Switzerland
events.summary: Guy Parmelin is sworn in as President of Switzerland, succeeding Karin Keller-Sutter.

events.title: Delcy Rodríguez is formally sworn in as acting and first female president of Venezuela
events.summary: Delcy Rodríguez is formally sworn in as acting and first female president of Venezuela following Nicolás Maduro's abduction and transfer out of the country.

events.title: The Syrian defense ministry declares a ceasefire in the Ashrafiyah
events.summary: The Syrian defense ministry declares a ceasefire in the Ashrafiyah, Bani Zeid, and Sheikh Maqsood districts of Aleppo after several days of armed conflict between government forces and the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces that killed at least 21 people.

events.title: 2026 Beninese parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Benin on 11 January 2026 to elect all 109 members of the National Assembly. The preliminary results of the election were announced on 17 January.

events.title: 2025–26 Myanmar general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Myanmar for elected seats in the Amyotha Hluttaw and the Pyithu Hluttaw of the Pyidaungsu Hluttaw in three phases, beginning on 28 December 2025 and concluding on 25 January 2026. The election is being held by Myanmar's military junta that came to power after the 2021 military coup d'état.

events.title: 2026 Ugandan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Uganda on 15 January 2026 to elect the President and the Parliament.

events.title: Yemeni prime minister Salem Saleh bin Braik resigns
events.summary: Yemeni prime minister Salem Saleh bin Braik resigns, and president Rashad al-Alimi appoints Shaea Muhssin to be the new prime minister.

events.title: 2026 Ugandan protests
events.summary: On 16 January 2026, protests and clashes began in Uganda in response to the 2026 Ugandan general election. Seven protesters were killed in the initial clashes.

events.title: Hands off Greenland protests
events.summary: The Hands off Greenland protests occurred in numerous cities and towns across Greenland and metropolitan Denmark on 17 January 2026. Organized in response to the Greenland crisis caused by United States president Donald Trump's threats to annex Greenland, they represent the largest protests ever held in Greenland.

events.title: 2026 Portuguese presidential election (first round)
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Portugal in 2026, with a first round on 18 January and a second round on 8 February. The incumbent president, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, supported by the Social Democratic Party (PSD), had already served two consecutive terms, so he was not eligible for re-election.

events.title: The Syrian government announces a ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces
events.summary: The Syrian government announces a ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces.

events.title: Vice president Iliyana Yotova is sworn in as acting president
events.summary: Bulgarian president Rumen Radev resigns, marking the first voluntary resignation of the country's president in its post-communist history. Vice president Iliyana Yotova is sworn in as acting president, becoming the country's first female president.

events.title: Thousands of people protest across Germany
events.summary: Thousands of people protest across Germany, particularly in Bremen, Dortmund, Frankfurt, in support of Kurdish forces against the Syrian Armed Forces in clashes in northeastern Syria.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Cyprus.

events.title: The African Union lifts sanctions on Guinea and restores its membership
events.summary: The African Union lifts sanctions on Guinea and restores its membership, citing progress in the country's political transition which culminated in Mamady Doumbouya's election as president.

events.title: Rumen Radev resigns as President of Bulgaria
events.summary: Rumen Radev resigned as President of Bulgaria on 23 January 2026, having held the office since 22 January 2022.

events.title: January 23, 2026 Minnesota protests against ICE
events.summary: The 2026 Minnesota ICE protests were large-scale protests held on January 23, 2026 across the state of Minnesota in opposition to expanded federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations and the Donald Trump administration's mass deportation policies.

events.title: 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam
events.summary: Vietnam's top leader, Tô Lâm, is re-elected as the General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the most powerful position in the one-party state.

events.title: The Syrian Democratic Forces and the Syrian government extend their ceasefire by 15 days to facilitate the United…
events.summary: The Syrian Democratic Forces and the Syrian government extend their ceasefire by 15 days to facilitate the United States-backed transfer of Islamic State detainees from Syria to Iraq.

events.title: 2025–26 Myanmar general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Myanmar for elected seats in the Amyotha Hluttaw and the Pyithu Hluttaw of the Pyidaungsu Hluttaw in three phases, beginning on 28 December 2025 and concluding on 25 January 2026. The election is being held by Myanmar's military junta that came to power after the 2021 military coup d'état.

events.title: Nasry Asfura takes power
events.summary: Nasry Juan Asfura Zablah is a Honduran politician and construction businessman serving as the president of Honduras since 2026. A member of the National Party of Honduras (PNH), he previously served as the mayor of Tegucigalpa from 2014 to 2022.

events.title: Nasry Asfura is sworn in as President of Honduras
events.summary: Nasry Asfura is sworn in as President of Honduras, succeeding Xiomara Castro.

events.title: Miroslav Lajčák resigns as a European Union Special Representative
events.summary: In Slovakia, Miroslav Lajčák resigns as a European Union Special Representative following the United States Department of Justice release of extensive correspondence between Lajčák and convicted child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein from 2017 to 2019, during which Lajčák served as the President of the United Nations General Assembly.

events.title: 2026 Costa Rican general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 1 February 2026 to elect the president, two vice-presidents, and all 57 deputies of the Legislative Assembly.

events.title: Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison's longtime chairman Brad S. Karp resigns
events.summary: Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison's longtime chairman Brad S. Karp resigns after emails between him and Jeffrey Epstein are published.

events.title: The United States Department of State issues sanctions on 14 oil tankers that are used to transport oil to Iran
events.summary: The United States Department of State issues sanctions on 14 oil tankers that are used to transport oil to Iran.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Islamabad mosque bombing
events.summary: On 6 February 2026, a suicide attack occurred at the Khadija Tul Kubra Mosque, a Shia mosque in the Tarlai Kalan area of southeastern Islamabad, Pakistan. The explosion occurred during Friday prayer, killing 31 people and injuring over 169 others.

events.title: 2025–26 Republika Srpska presidential election
events.summary: Early presidential elections were held in Republika Srpska, an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 23 November 2025, and repeated ones in 17 municipalities on 8 February 2026.

events.title: 2026 Japanese general election
events.summary: Early general elections were held in Japan on 8 February 2026 in all constituencies, including proportional blocks, to elect all 465 seats of the House of Representatives, the lower house of the National Diet.

events.title: Mona Juul, Norway's ambassador to Iraq and Jordan, resigns
events.summary: Mona Juul, Norway's ambassador to Iraq and Jordan, resigns after the foreign ministry opened an inquiry into her past contacts with Jeffrey Epstein, amid media reports that Epstein left money to her children.

events.title: 2026 Portuguese presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Portugal in 2026, with a first round on 18 January and a second round on 8 February. The incumbent president, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, supported by the Social Democratic Party (PSD), had already served two consecutive terms, so he was not eligible for re-election.

events.title: 2026 Thai constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Thailand alongside the general election on 8 February 2026 to ask voters whether they approve beginning the process of writing a new constitution to replace the current one adopted in 2017. It was approved by 60% of voters with a 69% turnout.

events.title: 2026 Thai general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Thailand on 8 February 2026 in order to determine the composition of the House of Representatives. A referendum was also held on the same day so as to determine whether the 2017 constitution should be replaced with a new one.

events.title: Morgan McSweeney, the chief of staff to British prime minister Keir Starmer, resigns
events.summary: Morgan McSweeney, the chief of staff to British prime minister Keir Starmer, resigns over his role in Peter Mandelson's appointment as ambassador to the U.S.

events.title: Protests against Israeli president Isaac Herzog's state visit
events.summary: Protests against Israeli president Isaac Herzog's state visit, following the 2025 Bondi Beach shooting, are held in cities across Australia. In Sydney, protests occurred amid a ban by the state government on hate speech grounds, resulting in police making 27 arrests and deploying pepper spray.

events.title: Portuguese home minister Maria Lúcia Amaral resigns
events.summary: Portuguese home minister Maria Lúcia Amaral resigns after criticism over the government's response to Storm Kristin and other storms.

events.title: 2026 Barbadian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Barbados on 11 February 2026 to elect the 30 members of the House of Assembly. Parliament was dissolved on 19 January and the final day for nominations was 27 January. The two leader candidates were Mia Mottley of the Barbados Labour Party and Ralph Thorne of the Democratic Labour Party.

events.title: The Constitutional Court of Slovakia suspends a criminal code amendment that would bar courts from accepting testimony…
events.summary: The Constitutional Court of Slovakia suspends a criminal code amendment that would bar courts from accepting testimony from cooperating witnesses who previously provided false statements.

events.title: 2026 Bangladeshi general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Bangladesh on 12 February 2026 to elect members of the Jatiya Sangsad. It was the first general election since the July Uprising of 2024 that ended the 15-year-long rule of Sheikh Hasina.

events.title: 2026 Bangladeshi constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum took place in Bangladesh on 12 February 2026, alongside the general election. Voters were asked about the provisions of the July Charter and related amendments to the Constitution of Bangladesh. "July National Charter Implementation Order, 2025" were issued for this purpose.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Cyprus.

events.title: 2026 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
events.summary: A leadership spill was held on 13 February 2026 to elect the leader of the Liberal Party of Australia, and by virtue, the leader of the Opposition. Angus Taylor was elected, defeating incumbent leader Sussan Ley. A spill for the deputy leadership was held concurrently, with Jane Hume being elected, defeating incumbent deputy leader Ted O'Brien.

events.title: Ley subsequently resigns from politics
events.summary: Angus Taylor replaces Sussan Ley as Leader of the Opposition following a leadership spill in the Liberal Party. Ley subsequently resigns from politics, triggering a by-election in her Farrer seat.

events.title: The High Court of Justice rules that the British government's decision to designate the pro-Palestinian activist group…
events.summary: The High Court of Justice rules that the British government's decision to designate the pro-Palestinian activist group Palestine Action as a terrorist organization is unlawful and disproportionate, while allowing the ban to remain in force pending appeal. The judgment prompts police to suspend further arrests linked to support for the group.

events.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026
events.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 was an international summit on artificial intelligence held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, India, from 16 to 21 February 2026. It is the fourth in a series of global AI summits following the Bletchley Park AI Safety Summit in 2023, the AI Seoul Summit in 2024, and the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025.

events.title: Bangladesh Nationalist Party leader Tarique Rahman is sworn in as the 11th prime minister of Bangladesh
events.summary: Bangladesh Nationalist Party leader Tarique Rahman is sworn in as the 11th prime minister of Bangladesh following the party's victory in the recent election.

events.title: Andrey Gyurov is sworn in as Prime Minister of Bulgaria
events.summary: Andrey Gyurov is sworn in as Prime Minister of Bulgaria.

events.title: The United States Supreme Court rules in Learning Resources v
events.summary: The United States Supreme Court rules in Learning Resources v. Trump that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not grant the President the power to impose trade tariffs.

events.title: United States president Donald Trump raises the global tariff on imports from 10% to 15% under emergency powers that…
events.summary: United States president Donald Trump raises the global tariff on imports from 10% to 15% under emergency powers that permit the measure for up to 150 days after the Supreme Court ruled yesterday that a 1977 law does not authorize the imposition of his earlier country-specific tariffs. The administration states that the new rate applies broadly, with exemptions for certain sectors and goods covered by existing trade agreements.

events.title: 2026 Laotian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Laos on 22 February 2026. Elections are held in a closed autocratic system and are not considered free or fair.

events.title: 9th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea
events.summary: North Korea's supreme leader, Kim Jong Un, is re-elected as the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the most powerful position in the one-party state.

events.title: Two days later Denisse Miralles is sworn in to this office
events.summary: Hernando de Soto is (falsely) announced as the new prime minister of Peru.. Two days later Denisse Miralles is sworn in to this office.

events.title: Rob Jetten takes power
events.summary: Rob Arnoldus Adrianus Jetten is a Dutch politician who has served as prime minister of the Netherlands since February 2026. He has also served as leader of the Democrats 66 (D66) since August 2023.

events.title: Rob Jetten is sworn in as the new prime minister of the Netherlands
events.summary: Rob Jetten is sworn in as the new prime minister of the Netherlands, becoming the country's youngest and its first openly gay prime minister.

events.title: Is sworn in as the new Prime Minister of Peru
events.summary: is sworn in as the new Prime Minister of Peru, succeeding Ernesto Álvarez Miranda.

events.title: The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil sentences former Rio de Janeiro legislators Chiquinho and Domingos Brazão to 76…
events.summary: The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil sentences former Rio de Janeiro legislators Chiquinho and Domingos Brazão to 76 years and three months in prison each for ordering the 2018 killing of city councilor Marielle Franco and her driver, convicting them of double aggravated homicide, participation in an armed criminal organization, and attempted murder.

events.title: The Supreme Court of Israel issues an interim order suspending a government ban on 37 foreign non-governmental…
events.summary: The Supreme Court of Israel issues an interim order suspending a government ban on 37 foreign non-governmental organizations operating in Gaza and the West Bank, allowing them to continue their operations while the court reviews a petition challenging the revocation of their legal status.

events.title: Assassination of Ali Khamenei
events.summary: On 28 February 2026, Ali Khamenei, the supreme leader of Iran, was assassinated in Tehran as part of a series of Israeli airstrikes aimed at high-ranking Iranian officials. Khamenei's death was confirmed by the Iranian government on 1 March.

events.title: Protests against the 2026 Iran war
events.summary: Following strikes against Iran on 28 February 2026 by a joint military operation conducted by Israel and the United States against the Government of Iran, including the assassination of Ali Khamenei, the long-time Supreme Leader of Iran, protests opposing the war were held in several countries.

events.title: Protests against the 2026 Iran war in the United States
events.summary: Following strikes against Iran on 28 February 2026 by a joint military operation conducted by Israel and the United States against the Government of Iran, including the assassination of Ali Khamenei, the long-time Supreme Leader of Iran, protests opposing the war were held in several countries.

events.title: 2026 attack on the United States consulate in Karachi
events.summary: On 1 March 2026, the Consulate General of the United States in Karachi, Pakistan, was targeted by Shia Muslim protesters following strikes on Iran by the US and Israel in which Iranian supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was assassinated.

events.title: The U.S. Department of State imposes sanctions on the Rwandan military for allegedly supporting the March 23 Movement…
events.summary: The U.S. Department of State imposes sanctions on the Rwandan military for allegedly supporting the March 23 Movement and violating a peace agreement with the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

events.title: The Supreme Court of Brazil orders the arrest of former Banco Master president and major shareholder Daniel Vorcaro in…
events.summary: The Supreme Court of Brazil orders the arrest of former Banco Master president and major shareholder Daniel Vorcaro in a fraud investigation of potentially up to 12 billion reals in missing funds.

events.title: 2026 Nepalese general election
events.summary: Early general elections were held in Nepal on 5 March 2026 to elect the 275 members of the House of Representatives as announced on 12 September 2025 by the President of Nepal, on the recommendation of the government of Nepal. The election was called after youth protests in September 2025 led to the resignation of Prime Minister K. P. Sharma Oli.

events.title: At the Shield of the Americas summit
events.summary: At the Shield of the Americas summit, U.S. president Trump says that the United States formally recognizes the Venezuelan government of Delcy Rodríguez.

events.title: 2026 Colombian parliamentary election
events.summary: The 2026 Colombian legislative elections were held on Sunday, March 8. They elected the members of both chambers of the Congress of Colombia for the 2026–2030 term, from a total of 3,144 candidates.

events.title: 2026 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2026, with national votes on 8 March, 14 June, 27 September and one planned for 29 November.

events.title: António José Seguro takes power
events.summary: António José Martins Seguro is a Portuguese politician who has been the president of Portugal since 2026, having won the 2026 Portuguese presidential election. A member of the Socialist Party (PS), Seguro previously served as secretary-general of the PS from 2011 to 2014, during which time he was also the leader of the opposition.

events.title: António José Seguro is sworn in as President of Portugal
events.summary: António José Seguro is sworn in as President of Portugal, succeeding Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa.

events.title: José Antonio Kast is sworn in as President of Chile
events.summary: José Antonio Kast is sworn in as President of Chile, succeeding Gabriel Boric.

events.title: The International Criminal Court at The Hague dismisses an investigation into whether U.S. sanctions against Venezuelan…
events.summary: The International Criminal Court at The Hague dismisses an investigation into whether U.S. sanctions against Venezuelan officials qualify as crimes against humanity.

events.title: 2025–2026 Iranian protests
events.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warns of a stronger response than in January if new protests against the regime erupt.

events.title: Protests are held in Italy against the war
events.summary: Protests are held in Italy against the war, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, and upcoming constitutional referendum in the country.

events.title: Protests against the 2026 Iran war
events.summary: Anti-war protests are held across Spain, including in Madrid, Barcelona, and Valencia, against both the Iran war and the Gaza war, reviving the "No to war" movement.

events.title: 2026 Republic of the Congo presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of the Congo on 15 March 2026. Incumbent president Denis Sassou Nguesso of the Congolese Party of Labour stood for re-election against six other candidates. Sassou Nguesso has ruled the Republic of the Congo since 1997, and previously held the presidency from 1979 to 1992.

events.title: 2026 Kazakh constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Kazakhstan on 15 March 2026 to determine whether to approve the draft of a new constitution of Kazakhstan. According to official results, it was supported by nearly 90% of voters, with 10% against, and a turnout of 73%, the highest for any national vote since 2019 and the largest for a referendum since 1995.

events.title: 2026 North Korean parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in North Korea on 15 March 2026 to elect the members of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly. Originally expected to be held in 2024, the elections were announced on 4 March 2026, shortly following the conclusion of the 9th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and Kim Jong Un's re-election as the General Secretary.

events.title: 2026 Vietnamese legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Vietnam on 15 March 2026. Early elections were held in the islands of the South Central Coast, Mekong Delta and Southeast regions from 26 February 2026.

events.title: The European Union imposes sanctions against 16 Iranian individuals and three entities for their role in suppressing…
events.summary: The European Union imposes sanctions against 16 Iranian individuals and three entities for their role in suppressing protests earlier this year.

events.title: The European Union imposes sanctions against nine Russian individuals
events.summary: The European Union imposes sanctions against nine Russian individuals over their role in the mass murder of civilians committed during Russia's occupation of Bucha during the initial 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

events.title: Assassination of Ali Larijani
events.summary: On 17 March 2026, Ali Larijani, the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, was assassinated in Tehran as part of a series of Israeli airstrikes aimed at high-ranking Iranian officials. His death occurred as part of the 2026 Iran war, which began on 28 February with airstrikes on various Iranian targets by the United States and Israel.

events.title: U.S. National Counterterrorism Center director Joe Kent resigns
events.summary: U.S. National Counterterrorism Center director Joe Kent resigns in protest of the war with Iran, saying that "Iran posed no imminent ⁠threat to our ⁠nation" and alleged the U.S. entered into the war due to pressure from Israel and its American lobby.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Cyprus.

events.title: Reactions to the 2025–2026 Iranian protests
events.summary: Iran executes three men arrested during protests last January by hanging.

events.title: The International Criminal Court at The Hague, Netherlands, rules that Tajikistan has violated the Rome Statute
events.summary: The International Criminal Court at The Hague, Netherlands, rules that Tajikistan has violated the Rome Statute after failing to arrest Russian President Vladimir Putin during his visit to the country in October 2025.

events.title: U.S. treasury secretary Scott Bessent announces that the U.S. will temporarily lift sanctions on Iranian oil at sea in…
events.summary: U.S. treasury secretary Scott Bessent announces that the U.S. will temporarily lift sanctions on Iranian oil at sea in an effort to ease energy supply pressures. The temporary relief will last for 30 days until April 19.

events.title: The 10th CELAC Summit is held in Bogotá
events.summary: The 10th CELAC Summit is held in Bogotá, Colombia.

events.title: 2026 Social Democratic Party (Japan) leadership election
events.summary: The 2026 Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 6 April 2026 to elect the next chairperson of the Social Democratic Party of Japan (SDP). The election was originally scheduled for 9 February 2026 but was postponed due to the 2026 general election following the dissolution of the House of Representatives.

events.title: 2026 Slovenian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovenia on 22 March 2026. The elections determined the composition of the National Assembly, which determines the government of Slovenia.

events.title: The Federal Court of Justice of Germany dismisses a lawsuit by Environmental Action Germany to ban BMW and Mercedes…
events.summary: The Federal Court of Justice of Germany dismisses a lawsuit by Environmental Action Germany to ban BMW and Mercedes Benz from selling new combustion engine vehicles after 2030.

events.title: 2026 Italian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum concerning the reform of the judicial system was held in Italy on 22 and 23 March 2026. Its purpose was to revise Title II and Title IV of Part II of the Italian constitution. It was the fifth constitutional referendum in the history of the Italian Republic.

events.title: 2026 Danish general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Denmark on 24 March 2026. All 179 seats in the Folketing were up for election, including 175 in Denmark proper, 2 in Greenland, and 2 in the Faroe Islands. It was the first election during Frederik X's reign, who became king in 2024 following the abdication of Margrethe II.

events.title: The Social Democrats, a reduced majority in the elections, Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen resigns
events.summary: After winning her party, the Social Democrats, a reduced majority in the elections, Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen resigns, but is tasked by King Frederik X with leading talks to form a new government.

events.title: Kosovo's Constitutional Court rules that President Vjosa Osmani's decree to dissolve had no legal effect
events.summary: Kosovo's Constitutional Court rules that President Vjosa Osmani's decree to dissolve had no legal effect, giving the Kuvendi 34 more days to elect the next president before automatically moving to new elections within 45 days.

events.title: Tajik president Emomali Rahmon and Uzbek president Shavkat Mirziyoyev inaugurate the Tajikistan embassy in Tashkent…
events.summary: Tajik president Emomali Rahmon and Uzbek president Shavkat Mirziyoyev inaugurate the Tajikistan embassy in Tashkent during Rahmon's state visit to Uzbekistan.

events.title: Lawmakers from the Jammu & Kashmir National Conference protest outside the legislative assembly of Jammu and Kashmir
events.summary: Lawmakers from the Jammu & Kashmir National Conference protest outside the legislative assembly of Jammu and Kashmir, India, in solidarity with Iran and against the assassination of former supreme leader Ali Khamenei amidst the Iran war. Additionally, a major confrontation breaks out between INC lawmaker Irfan Hafiz Lone and BJP lawmaker Yudhvir Sethi during the protest.

events.title: March 2026 No Kings protests
events.summary: The March 2026 No Kings protests were a group of coordinated protests that took place on March 28, 2026. They were part of a series of demonstrations in the United States to protest the actions and policies of the second Trump administration, including the 2026 Iran war, democratic backsliding / growing authoritarian tendencies, suppression of the Epstein…

events.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court overturns Colorado's ban on conversion therapy in an 8–1 decision, ruling that it infringed on the First Amendment, thereby invalidating similar bans in 22 other states.

events.title: Epidemic: MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak
events.summary: In April 2026, an outbreak of hantavirus infection caused by the Andes virus was identified on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius. There were ten confirmed cases and two suspected cases directly linked to the outbreak as of 22 May. events.title: Alice Mina and Vladimiro Selva are sworn in as the new Captains Regent of San Marino

events.summary: The United States lifts sanctions on Venezuelan acting president Delcy Rodríguez.

events.summary: The Israeli High Court of Justice orders police to allow anti-war protests in Israel.

events.title: 2026 Maldivian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in the Maldives on Saturday 4 April 2026, the same day as the local elections. The referendum asked voters whether they support shortening the current parliamentary term and amending the Constitution so that presidential and parliamentary elections are held on the same day in 2028.

events.title: 2026 Irish fuel protests
events.summary: A series of nationwide protests occurred from 7–14 April in the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland in response to rapidly rising fuel prices and broader cost-of-living pressures.

events.title: 2026 Iran war ceasefire
events.summary: On 8 April 2026, the United States and Iran agreed to a two-week ceasefire in the 2026 Iran war, mediated by Pakistan. Iran had rejected the draft proposal for a 45-day two-phase ceasefire framework introduced on 5 April by Pakistan, instead proposing its own 10-point plan for a peace agreement.

events.title: Russian president Vladimir Putin declares a ceasefire for the weekend in Ukraine for Orthodox Easter
events.summary: Russian president Vladimir Putin declares a ceasefire for the weekend in Ukraine for Orthodox Easter.

events.title: The Supreme Court of Russia designates the human rights group Memorial as an extremist organization and bans its…
events.summary: The Supreme Court of Russia designates the human rights group Memorial as an extremist organization and bans its activities following a petition by the Ministry of Justice.

events.title: 2026 Djiboutian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Djibouti on 10 April 2026. Incumbent fifth term president Ismaïl Omar Guelleh was re-elected to a sixth term, having been president since 1999. Originally ineligible for a sixth term due to an age limit of 75, a constitutional amendment was passed in 2025 that allowed him to run again.

events.title: The parliament of South Korea approves a supplementary budget worth ₩26.2 trillion (US$17.7 billion) to address the…
events.summary: The parliament of South Korea approves a supplementary budget worth ₩26.2 trillion (US$17.7 billion) to address the economic effects of the war, which includes cash assistance to 35 million South Koreans.

events.title: 2026 Beninese presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Benin on 12 April 2026, following the 11 January parliamentary elections conducted in accordance with the national electoral code. President Patrice Talon, serving his second and final constitutional term, had maintained that he would not seek a constitutional amendment to pursue re-election.

events.title: 2026 Coalition Avenir Québec leadership election
events.summary: From April 7 to 12, 2026, members of the Coalition Avenir Québec (CAQ) voted in a leadership election to choose a successor for François Legault, who announced his resignation in January amid unfavourable opinion polling.

events.title: 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 12 April 2026 to elect all 199 members of the National Assembly. It was the 10th parliamentary election and the highest-turnout election since Hungary's transition to democracy in 1990.

events.title: Nizar Amidi, elected the previous day, takes office as President of Iraq
events.summary: Nizar Amidi, elected the previous day, takes office as President of Iraq, succeeding Abdul Latif Rashid.

events.title: 2026 Peruvian general election (first round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Peru from 12 to 13 April 2026 to elect the president, vice presidents, and the Congress of the Republic of Peru. As no presidential candidate achieved a majority of votes in the first round, a runoff election was held on 7 June.

events.title: Visits by Pope Leo XIV to Algeria, Cameroon, Angola, and Equatorial Guinea
events.summary: Pope Leo XIV visited Algeria, Cameroon, Angola, and Equatorial Guinea from April 13 to 23, 2026. This trip was this pope's third trip outside of Italy and first to Africa since his election in May 2025. The Holy See released the Pope's itinerary and transcripts of his addresses publicly in March.

events.title: Ambazonian militant groups announce a temporary ceasefire in Cameroon
events.summary: Ambazonian militant groups announce a temporary ceasefire in Cameroon after nearly a decade of conflict in anticipation of Pope Leo XIV's visit on April 15.

events.title: The Government of the 34th Dáil wins a no confidence vote tabled by Sinn Féin
events.summary: In the Republic of Ireland, the Government of the 34th Dáil wins a no confidence vote tabled by Sinn Féin over its handling of recent fuel protests.

events.title: Christine Fréchette is sworn in as Premier of Quebec

events.title: 2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire
events.summary: The 2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire is a cessation of hostilities agreed between Israel and Lebanon on 16 April 2026, amid the ongoing 2026 Lebanon war and wider regional conflict linked to the 2026 Iran war.

events.title: The Trump administration imposes sanctions against two sons of Nicaragua co-presidents Daniel Ortega and Rosario…
events.summary: The Trump administration imposes sanctions against two sons of Nicaragua co-presidents Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo along with other officials tied to the gold industry in the country.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Kyiv shooting
events.summary: On 18 April 2026, a mass shooting occurred in the Demiivka neighborhood of the Holosiivskyi District of Kyiv, Ukraine, when a man opened fire on his neighbours and passers-by in the street before taking hostages inside a supermarket. He was shot and killed by police in a shootout when the Rapid Operational Response Unit (KORD) stormed the supermarket.

events.title: 2026 Bulgarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Bulgaria on 19 April 2026 to elect 240 members of the National Assembly. The vote was triggered by the resignation of the Zhelyazkov government on 11 December 2025 following widespread anti-corruption protests.

events.title: 2026 state visit by Javier Milei to Israel
events.summary: On 19 April 2026, President of Argentina Javier Milei arrived in Jerusalem to pay his third state visit to the State of Israel since his inauguration in December 2023. During the three-day visit, Milei met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Isaac Herzog.

events.title: Visit by Pope Leo XIV to Algeria, Cameroon, Angola, and Equatorial Guinea
events.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Malabo, the final leg of his papal visit to Africa, becoming the first pope to visit Equatorial Guinea since John Paul II in 1982.

events.title: United States president Donald Trump announces that the ceasefire will be extended so that Iran can make a "unified…

events.title: New Zealand prime minister Christopher Luxon secures the support of his caucus after initiating and winning a…

events.title: Nepali home minister Sudan Gurung resigns to allow an impartial investigation into his financial activities
events.summary: Nepali home minister Sudan Gurung resigns to allow an impartial investigation into his financial activities, becoming the second minister to leave prime minister Balen Shah's government following recent elections.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Cyprus.

events.title: The European Union sanctions two Uzbekistan-based cotton manufacturing plants for supplying raw material to the Russian…
events.summary: The European Union sanctions two Uzbekistan-based cotton manufacturing plants for supplying raw material to the Russian defense industry.

events.summary: Outgoing Hungarian prime minister Viktor Orbán announces that he will resign from his seat in parliament after his defeat in the recent election that ended his 16-year tenure in Hungary. However, he also stated that he plans to remain as leader of Fidesz.

events.title: 2025–26 Central African general election (second round)
events.summary: General elections were held in the Central African Republic (CAR) on 28 December 2025 to elect both the president and National Assembly. A second round of the legislative elections was held on 26 April 2026. The incumbent president, Faustin-Archange Touadéra, was seeking a third term following the removal of term limits in a constitutional referendum.

events.summary: The Parliament of Romania votes 281–4 to pass a motion of no confidence, called by the Social Democratic Party and Alliance for the Union of Romanians, against prime minister Ilie Bolojan.

events.summary: Rumen Radev is sworn in as prime minister of Bulgaria after being elected in a vote of 124–70, with 36 abstentions at the National Assembly.

events.summary: Péter Magyar is a Hungarian politician who has served as prime minister of Hungary since May 2026. He has been the president of the Tisza Party since 2024 and was a member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2024 to 2026.

events.summary: Andris Sprūds resigns as Latvian defence minister after Ukrainian drones violated Latvian airspace during an attack on Russia.

events.summary: Christian Schmidt announces his resignation as High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina. He will stay in office until a replacement is found.

events.title: 2026 Australian federal budget

events.title: 2026 Bahamian general election

events.title: 2026 state visit by Donald Trump to China
events.summary: From 13 to 15 May 2026, the president of the United States Donald Trump made a state visit to China. This trip was also the first by a U.S. president since Trump's visit in 2017.

events.title: 2026 Bolivian protests

events.title: Evika Siliņa resigns as Prime Minister of Latvia
events.summary: Evika Siliņa resigned as Prime Minister of Latvia on 14 May 2026, having held the office since 15 September 2023.

events.title: Wes Streeting resigns as Secretary of State for Health and Social Care
events.summary: Wes Streeting resigned as Secretary of State for Health and Social Care on 14 May 2026, having held the office since 5 July 2024.

events.title: The United States announces that Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend their ceasefire for 45 days
events.summary: The United States announces that Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend their ceasefire for 45 days, and that more specific political and security negotiations will begin on May 29 and June 2, respectively.

events.title: Protests against the 2026 Iran war
events.summary: One person dies and five others are injured in clashes between protesters and security forces in Anjouan, Comoros, as demonstrations continue over rising fuel prices partially attributed to the Iran war.

events.title: 2026 Long Island Rail Road strike
events.summary: The Long Island Rail Road is a railroad owned by the Metropolitan Transportation Authority in the U.S. state of New York. It is the oldest United States railroad still operating under its original name and charter. It consolidated several other companies in the late 19th century.

events.title: 2026 Cape Verdean parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Cape Verde on 17 May 2026 to elect all 72 members of the National Assembly. The African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde (PAICV) won a majority of seats, unseating the Movement for Democracy (MpD). PAICV leader Francisco Carvalho has been named prime minister–designate of Cape Verde.

events.title: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control imposes sanctions on Cuba's intelligence agency and several senior Communist…

events.title: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control removes sanctions on Francesca Albanese
events.summary: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control removes sanctions on Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on occupied Palestinian territories, after district judge Richard J. Leon of the District of Columbia blocked measures imposed over Albanese's criticism of Israel and its actions in Gaza.

events.title: 2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests

events.title: Thousands of people march through Madrid
events.summary: Thousands of people march through Madrid, Spain, demanding the resignation of prime minister Pedro Sánchez following several corruption scandals involving his cabinet and his family.

events.title: Romuald Wadagni is sworn in as the president of Benin

events.title: 2026 Cypriot legislative election

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Quetta train bombing
events.summary: On 24 May 2026, a vehicle-borne suicide bombing targeted a shuttle train near Chaman Phatak in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan. The explosion killed at least 47 people and injured 98 others.

events.title: Residents of Kraków, Poland, have overwhelmingly backed the dismissal of Mayor Aleksander Miszalski (Civic Platform)…
events.summary: Residents of Kraków, Poland, have overwhelmingly backed the dismissal of Mayor Aleksander Miszalski (Civic Platform) and the city council in a local recall referendum for the first time in the city's history. Exit polls have shown a 33.4% voter turnout with 97.8% of voters backing dismissing Miszalski, while 96.0% supported removing the council.

events.title: Malick Ndiaye resigns as National Assembly president
events.summary: In Senegal, Malick Ndiaye resigns as National Assembly president following the dismissal of prime minister Ousmane Sonko, clearing the way for Sonko to seek the parliament's presidency amid tensions within the ruling coalition.

events.title: Thousands of people protest in Madrid

events.title: Andris Kulbergs takes power

events.title: 2026 Maltese general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Malta on 30 May 2026, with 356,832 registered voters entitled to vote to elect all members of the House of Representatives. The ruling Labour Party led by Robert Abela won the election, securing 36 seats with 52% of the first preference vote.

events.title: 2026 Guinean parliamentary election

events.summary: The 2026 Hamburg Olympic referendum was a citywide referendum held on 31 May 2026 in the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg. events.title: 2026 Ethiopian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Ethiopia on 1 June 2026 to elect members of the House of Peoples' Representatives. The ruling Prosperity Party of prime minister Abiy Ahmed won a majority of 438 seats.
