The United States Geological Survey located the epicenter approximately 25 km (16 mi) southwest of Kablalan at a depth of about 57 km (35 mi), while the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology located it 32 km (20 mi) south of Maasim,…

events.title: 2026 state visit by Xi Jinping to North Korea
events.summary: From 8 to 9 June 2026, Xi Jinping, the general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party and president of China, and his wife Peng Liyuan made a state visit to North Korea, received by Kim Jong Un, the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the president of the State Affairs Commission, and his wife Ri Sol-ju.

events.title: 2026 Northern Ireland riots
events.summary: On 9 June 2026, riots broke out across Belfast following a stabbing attack allegedly committed by an African man the previous evening. Further protests were reported across Northern Ireland and in Glasgow and Edinburgh in Scotland, as well as Southampton in England.

events.title: Protests against the 2026 Iran war
events.summary: Hundreds of people rally in Hezbollah strongholds in southern suburbs of Beirut, Lebanon, in support of Iran and its allies during the war. Additionally, the Al-Masirah, a TV channel run by the Houthis, reports a similar gathering in Sanaa, Yemen.

events.title: China imposes sanctions on Philippine defense secretary Gilbert Teodoro
events.summary: China imposes sanctions on Philippine defense secretary Gilbert Teodoro, citing remarks he made at the recent Shangri-La Dialogue that China said undermined its interests and bilateral relations. China also bans him, his wife, and their son from entering the mainland, Hong Kong, and Macau.

events.title: John Healey resigns as Secretary of State for Defence
events.summary: John Healey resigned as Secretary of State for Defence on 11 June 2026, having held the office since 5 July 2024.

events.title: June 2026 Indonesian protests
events.summary: June 2026 Indonesia protest also known as Indonesian Bankruptcy Demonstration is a series of demonstrations that began on June 12, 2026 to protest the poor management of the state and its budget during the leadership of Prabowo Subianto and Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

events.title: 2025–2026 Indonesian protests
events.summary: Hundreds of students protest against Indonesian president Prabowo Subianto prompted by a fuel price hike, governmental tensions, and mismanaged government spending on the Free Nutritious Meals program.

events.title: Pakistani prime minister Shehbaz Sharif and United States president Donald Trump announce that Iran and the U.S. have…
events.summary: Pakistani prime minister Shehbaz Sharif and United States president Donald Trump announce that Iran and the U.S. have reached an agreement to end the war, extend the ceasefire by 60 more days, and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with the deal set to be officially signed in Switzerland on Friday.

events.title: 2026 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2026, with national votes on 8 March, 14 June, 27 September and one planned for 29 November.

events.title: 52nd G7 summit
events.summary: The 52nd G7 Summit was an annual summit of the G7 held from 15 to 17 June 2026 in Évian-les-Bains, Haute-Savoie, France.

events.title: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court sentences former São Paulo congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro to four years and two months in…
events.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court sentences former São Paulo congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro to four years and two months in prison and bars him from holding public office for eight years after convicting him of threatening public officials in connection with U.S. sanctions efforts.

events.title: The entire cabinet of Equatorial Guinea, led by prime minister Manuel Osa Nsue Nsua, resigns
events.summary: The entire cabinet of Equatorial Guinea, led by prime minister Manuel Osa Nsue Nsua, resigns after reaching under 10% of targets surrounding economic diversification.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Cyprus.

events.title: 2026 Bolivian protests
events.summary: Bolivian president Rodrigo Paz and the Bolivian Workers' Confederation trade union reach an agreement aimed at easing a 50-day protest crisis marked by road blockades and supply shortages. Other protest groups continue demonstrations and demand Paz's resignation.

events.title: The United States announces that Israel and Hezbollah agreed to a ceasefire
events.summary: The United States announces that Israel and Hezbollah agreed to a ceasefire.

events.title: 2026 Colombian presidential election (second round)
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 31 May 2026. Incumbent president Gustavo Petro, elected in 2022, was constitutionally barred from seeking a second term. Abelardo de la Espriella defeated Iván Cepeda by less than 1% in the run-off election held on 21 June 2026.

events.title: The U.S. treasury department lifts sanctions against Iran and authorizes the production
events.summary: The U.S. treasury department lifts sanctions against Iran and authorizes the production, delivery and sale of Iranian oil for 60 days amidst ongoing talks in Switzerland.

events.title: The Supreme Court of Japan upholds the Tokyo High Court's order to dissolve the Unification Church
events.summary: The Supreme Court of Japan upholds the Tokyo High Court's order to dissolve the Unification Church.

events.title: Keir Starmer announces his resignation as British prime minister and leader of the Labour Party in an address to the…
events.summary: Keir Starmer announces his resignation as British prime minister and leader of the Labour Party in an address to the nation outside 10 Downing Street, London. He will remain as caretaker prime minister until a new party leader is elected.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes
events.summary: On 24 June 2026, doublet large strike-slip earthquakes affected northwestern and central Venezuela. The epicenter of the first earthquake was in Veroes Municipality, west of San Felipe, the capital city of Yaracuy. This earthquake, which measured Mw 7.2, occurred at 18:04 VET and was classified as a foreshock.

events.title: The Congress of Deputies approves a motion calling on the prime minister Pedro Sánchez to face a vote of confidence
events.summary: In Spain, the Congress of Deputies approves a motion calling on the prime minister Pedro Sánchez to face a vote of confidence following the escalation of corruption cases involving his PSOE party and his family.

events.title: Gen Z protests
events.summary: Indonesian police arrest at least 24 protesters following a demonstration in Surabaya, East Java, against fuel price increases and government policies. The arrests occur after clashes in which some participants threw objects and set fires in the street.
events.refName: AFP via South China Morning Post

events.title: Argentine cabinet chief and government spokesperson Manuel Adorni resigns
events.summary: Argentine cabinet chief and government spokesperson Manuel Adorni resigns following weeks of controversy over his wealth.

events.title: Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić announces his intention to resign within weeks
events.summary: Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić announces his intention to resign within weeks amid anti-corruption protests and will call for early presidential and parliamentary elections.

events.title: Gaza war protests
events.summary: Demonstrators rally in central Stockholm, Sweden, including the Odenplan area, against Israeli strikes against Gaza and restrictions on humanitarian aid entering the enclave.

events.title: The U.S. treasury department announces sanctions on two men and nine companies accused of being involved in…
events.summary: The U.S. treasury department announces sanctions on two men and nine companies accused of being involved in transportation, financial services, and real estate for the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.

events.title: 2025–2026 Philippine anti-corruption protests
events.summary: More than 14,000 people participate in rallies organized by the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC) in Metro Manila, Philippines, mainly to support senator and INC member Rodante Marcoleta who is under investigation for plunder. Five people are arrested at the People Power Monument in Quezon City and three police officers are injured.

events.title: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as Director of National Intelligence
events.summary: Tulsi Gabbard resigned as Director of National Intelligence on 30 June 2026, having held the office since 12 February 2025.

events.title: The Supreme Court of the United States rules 6–3 that president Donald Trump's executive order restricting birthright…
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States rules 6–3 that president Donald Trump's executive order restricting birthright citizenship violates the 14th Amendment, with chief justice John Roberts writing that citizenship "was the right to have rights."

events.title: Christian Schmidt resigns as the High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina
events.summary: Christian Schmidt resigns as the High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina, with Principal Deputy Louis Crishock being appointed as acting High Representative.

events.title: Flamingo Revolution
events.summary: Police clash with demonstrators in Albania during a protest against the government and the Sazan Island Resort project.

events.title: 2026 Algerian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Algeria on 2 July 2026.

events.title: Protests and uprisings in Tibet since 1950
events.summary: A man protesting against the annexation of Tibet by China lights himself on fire outside of the headquarters of the United Nations in New York City, United States. He is transported to Bellevue Hospital where he dies from his injuries.

events.title: Moldovan prime minister Alexandru Munteanu resigns
events.summary: Moldovan prime minister Alexandru Munteanu resigns.

events.title: 2026 Slovak referendum
events.summary: A two-part referendum was held in Slovakia on 4 July 2026. The questions were on whether to cancel life payments for leaders after their terms expire, and whether to reestablish the Special Prosecutor's Office and the National Criminal Agency.

events.title: Pakistani president Asif Ali Zardari begins a four-day visit to Kyrgyzstan
events.summary: Pakistani president Asif Ali Zardari begins a four-day visit to Kyrgyzstan after an invitation from Kyrgyz president Sadyr Japarov, making it the first official visit by a Pakistani president to the country in 21 years.

events.title: 2026 Ankara NATO summit
events.summary: The 2026 Ankara summit was a meeting of heads of state and heads of government of NATO member states, held in Ankara, Turkey, on 7–8 July 2026. It is the 36th NATO summit and the second hosted by Turkey following the 2004 summit in Istanbul. The summit took place at the Presidential Complex.

events.title: Thousands of people protest in Budapest
events.summary: Thousands of people protest in Budapest, Hungary, against the attempt by prime minister Péter Magyar to oust president Tamás Sulyok, whom Magyar accuses of failing to "live up" to his role by not opposing what he calls antidemocratic measures by former prime minister Viktor Orbán.

events.title: Senegal's Constitutional Council strikes down a parliamentary bill that would expand the powers of the National…
events.summary: Senegal's Constitutional Council strikes down a parliamentary bill that would expand the powers of the National Assembly and prime minister while limiting presidential authority, after president Bassirou Diomaye Faye challenges the measure.

events.title: The European Parliament votes 476–28 with 96 abstentions to adopt a resolution calling on the European Union to…
events.summary: The European Parliament votes 476–28 with 96 abstentions to adopt a resolution calling on the European Union to designate the Rapid Support Forces as a terrorist organization and impose sanctions on individuals responsible for attacks on civilians in El-Obeid, North Kordofan.

events.title: Ukrainian prime minister Yulia Svyrydenko steps down as president Volodymyr Zelenskyy announces a cabinet reshuffle and…
events.summary: Ukrainian prime minister Yulia Svyrydenko steps down as president Volodymyr Zelenskyy announces a cabinet reshuffle and changes to law enforcement leadership, citing the need to implement an updated political strategy during Russia's invasion.

events.title: The European Union imposes sanctions against Sudan's gold trade
events.summary: The European Union imposes sanctions against Sudan's gold trade, accusing them of financing the civil war in the country.

events.title: Mindaugas Sinkevičius takes power
events.summary: Mindaugas Sinkevičius is a Lithuanian manager and politician, who has served as the 20th Prime Minister of Lithuania since 14 July 2026. He also served as Mayor of Jonava District Municipality, former Minister of Economy of Lithuania (2016–2017) and Vice-Mayor of Jonava (2008–2011).

events.title: A prosecutor at the International Criminal Court drop charges against former rebel leader Abdallah Banda
events.summary: A prosecutor at the International Criminal Court drop charges against former rebel leader Abdallah Banda over his role in a 2007 attack on African Union peacekeepers during Sudan's Darfur conflict.

events.title: South Korea's Supreme Court upholds People Power Party lawmaker Kweon Seong-dong's two-year prison sentence for…
events.summary: South Korea's Supreme Court upholds People Power Party lawmaker Kweon Seong-dong's two-year prison sentence for accepting ₩100 million (US$67,400) in illegal political funds from the Unification Church, removing him from the National Assembly.

events.title: Ukrainian Air Force deputy commander Pavlo Yelizarov resigns from his position
events.summary: Ukrainian Air Force deputy commander Pavlo Yelizarov resigns from his position in protest of Fedorov's removal as defense minister.

events.title: 2026 Labour Party leadership election
events.summary: Andy Burnham is elected as the new leader of the British Labour Party. He will formally succeed Keir Starmer as prime minister on Monday.

events.title: Jens Spahn resigns as leader of the governing CDU/CSU alliance in Germany's Bundestag
events.summary: Jens Spahn resigns as leader of the governing CDU/CSU alliance in Germany's Bundestag amid criticism after he and his husband became parents through surrogacy, despite Germany's ban and his party's opposition to the practice.

events.title: 2026 Delhi Jantar Mantar protests
events.summary: Students hold protests in several cities across India after activist Sonam Wangchuk is arrested and taken to a hospital during his hunger strike calling for education minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over the 2026 NEET exam paper leak, with a march on Parliament planned for the following day.

events.title: 2026 São Toméan presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 19 July 2026. Incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round, this time running as an independent candidate with support from MLSTP–PSD, receiving 55.88% of the vote, while his main opposition candidate, Nito Abreu, who was supported by Vila Nova's former party Independent…

events.title: Sansad Chalo march
events.summary: The Sansad Chalo march was a political march organised by the Indian youth movement Cockroach Janta Party on 20 July 2026, demanding accountability for national competitive examination paper leaks and the resignation of Union Minister of Education Dharmendra Pradhan.

events.title: 2026 The Democrats primaries
events.summary: A primary election was held by The Democrats on 20 July 2026 to select its list of candidates ahead of the 2026 Israeli legislative election.

events.title: The United States imposes new sanctions upon the Sudanese military junta
events.summary: The United States imposes new sanctions upon the Sudanese military junta, alleging the use of chemical weapons including chlorine gas in the civil war.

events.title: Andy Burnham takes power
events.summary: Andrew Murray Burnham is a British politician who has served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Labour Party since July 2026.

events.title: Sir Keir Starmer resigns as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
events.summary: Sir Keir Starmer resigns as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, and is succeeded by Andy Burnham.

events.title: 2026 Australian Labor Party National Conference
events.summary: The 2026 Australian Labor Party National Conference was the 50th triennial political party conference of the Australian Labor Party. It took place in Adelaide, South Australia from 23 to 25 July 2026.

events.title: The International Criminal Court at The Hague, Netherlands, officially drops charges against former militia leader…
events.summary: The International Criminal Court at The Hague, Netherlands, officially drops charges against former militia leader Abdallah Banda, who was previously charged for his role in a 2007 attack on African Union peacekeepers during Sudan's Darfur conflict.

events.title: Bangladeshi president Mohammed Shahabuddin resigns from office
events.summary: Bangladeshi president Mohammed Shahabuddin resigns from office, citing health reasons.

events.title: The European Union sanctions five Iranian judges
events.summary: The European Union sanctions five Iranian judges over alleged human rights violations and Ashiyane cyber group founder Nima Salehi, whom it accuses of cooperating with Iranian authorities to suppress information.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Berlin Pride attack
events.summary: On the evening of 25 July 2026, 21-year-old Lebanese-German Abdul Ballout drove a van into a crowd of pedestrians during Berlin Christopher Street Day, a pride celebration in the Tiergarten in central Berlin, Germany. One woman was killed and 29 people were injured, several critically. Ballout fled on foot, and a large-scale manhunt was launched.

events.title: Indian education minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigns
events.summary: Indian education minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigns after protests over alleged entrance-examination leaks and broader education-system irregularities. His resignation marks the Modi government's first major concession to the demonstrations.

events.title: Victorian premier Jacinta Allan resigns
events.summary: In Australia, Victorian premier Jacinta Allan resigns, triggering a leadership spill. Ben Carroll is elected unanimously as the new Premier and Victorian Labor Party leader.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Kumamoto earthquake
events.summary: On 28 July 2026 at approximately 16:27:15 JST, an earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan with a magnitude of Mww 6.8 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi), later revised to 16 km (9.9 mi). At least 38 people were killed and more than 368 were injured.

events.title: Keiko Fujimori is sworn in as President of Peru
events.summary: Keiko Fujimori is sworn in as President of Peru after winning the general election in June.

events.title: The United States Senate votes 86–12 to advance legislation imposing sanctions on Russia's energy revenues
events.summary: The United States Senate votes 86–12 to advance legislation imposing sanctions on Russia's energy revenues, financial institutions, officials, and shadow fleet, while authorizing tariffs of up to 100% on major buyers of Russian oil and gas.

events.title: 2026 Bolivian protests
events.summary: Bolivian prosecutors issue an arrest warrant for former president Evo Morales for allegedly organizing protests and roadblocks across the country in May and June. The investigation follows complaints alleging armed uprising and terrorism.

events.title: The United States Treasury Department lifts sanctions against Fly Baghdad
events.summary: The United States Treasury Department lifts sanctions against Fly Baghdad, which were previously imposed in 2024 over its links to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Quds Force.

events.title: Inauguration of Abelardo de la Espriella
events.summary: Abelardo de la Espriella's inauguration as the 36th President of Colombia took place on Friday, August 7, 2026. It was the 40th Colombian presidential inauguration marking the beginning of his four-year term as president and José Manuel Restrepo as vice president.

events.title: The United States Senate votes 86–11 to pass a bill imposing sanctions on Russia's energy revenues
events.summary: The United States Senate votes 86–11 to pass a bill imposing sanctions on Russia's energy revenues, financial institutions, officials, and shadow fleet, while authorizing tariffs of up to 100% on major buyers of Russian oil and gas. The legislation will head to the U.S. House of Representatives for a vote.

events.title: Treaty signed: Mecca Defence Alliance
events.summary: The Mecca Defence Alliance, also known as the Mecca Pact or Makkah Alliance, is an intergovernmental military alliance in the Muslim world that was signed into force by Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey on 7 August 2026.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Colombia earthquake
events.summary: On 10 August 2026, a Mw 7.4–7.5 earthquake struck the department of Chocó in Colombia, killing at least 335 people, injuring more than 4,600 others, leaving 111 confirmed missing and causing extensive damage across the country.

events.title: 2026 Hungarian presidential election
events.summary: An early indirect presidential election was held in Hungary on 11 August 2026 following Tamás Sulyok's removal by constitutional amendment. András Baka, a former president of the Supreme Court of Hungary, was nominated by the governing Tisza Party and was elected with a two-thirds majority.

events.title: The Rapid Support Forces-appointed governor of Sudan's Kordofan region, Hamad Mohammad Hamad Khalifa, resigns and…
events.summary: The Rapid Support Forces-appointed governor of Sudan's Kordofan region, Hamad Mohammad Hamad Khalifa, resigns and announces he will defect.

events.title: 2026 Zambian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Zambia on 13 August 2026 to elect a president, members of the National Assembly, councillors and council chairs.

events.title: The Constitutional Council of France blocks a bill proposing a ban on social media access for minors under the age of 15
events.summary: The Constitutional Council of France blocks a bill proposing a ban on social media access for minors under the age of 15. President Emmanuel Macron orders prime minister Sebastien Lecornu to re-work the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council.

events.title: 2026 Likud primary
events.summary: A primary election was held by Likud on 17 August 2026 to select its list of candidates ahead of the 2026 Israeli legislative election.

events.title: Former South Korean prime minister Kim Min-seok is elected as the new leader of the Democratic Party with 54.08% of the…
events.summary: Former South Korean prime minister Kim Min-seok is elected as the new leader of the Democratic Party with 54.08% of the vote against its former leader Jung Chung-rae.

events.title: Pakistan's Supreme Court orders imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan transferred from the central jail in…
events.summary: Pakistan's Supreme Court orders imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan transferred from the central jail in Rawalpindi, Punjab, to Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad for medical examinations following a petition by his lawyers concerning his health.

events.title: The United States imposes sanctions on International Criminal Court (ICC) president Tomoko Akane and senior trial…
events.summary: The United States imposes sanctions on International Criminal Court (ICC) president Tomoko Akane and senior trial lawyer Abdoulaye Seye over their alleged involvement in proceedings against officials from countries that do not recognize ICC jurisdiction.

events.title: U.S. president Donald Trump announces an economic war against Iran
events.summary: U.S. president Donald Trump announces an economic war against Iran, along with new sanctions for countries trading with Iran.

events.title: The U.S. Treasury Department issues sanctions on 15 people allegedly involved in a drug trafficking network shipping…
events.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department issues sanctions on 15 people allegedly involved in a drug trafficking network shipping thousands of kilograms of cocaine from Ecuador through Mexico to the United States.

events.title: India's Supreme Court orders states to protect elephant corridors
events.summary: India's Supreme Court orders states to protect elephant corridors, identify and remove obstructions, and prohibit groups from using fire to drive wild elephants away amid increasing habitat loss and human-elephant conflict.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV makes a half-day papal visit to San Marino
events.summary: Pope Leo XIV makes a half-day papal visit to San Marino, including meeting with the Captains Regent, the local religious community, and visiting the Basilica of Saint Marinus.

events.title: 2026 Kazakh legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Kazakhstan on 23 August 2026 to elect all 145 members of the Kurultai of the 1st convocation. It was the 10th legislative election since Kazakhstan's independence in 1991 and the first election to the country's new unicameral legislature established by the 2026 Constitution.

events.title: Emmanuel Nchimbi announces his resignation as the vice president of Tanzania
events.summary: Emmanuel Nchimbi announces his resignation as the vice president of Tanzania.

events.title: Natural disaster: 2026 Nepal–Tibet floods
events.summary: On the morning of 26 August 2026, a series of flash floods and debris flows destroyed the Gyirong Port on the China–Nepal border and struck dozens of settlements along a 72 km (45 mi) stretch of the Trishuli River in Nepal. These events are also known as the 2026 Nepal-China floods, Bhotekoshi flood, or Rasuwa flood.

events.title: 2026 Icelandic European Union membership negotiations referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the resumption of European Union membership negotiations by the Icelandic government was held in Iceland on 29 August 2026. Its result was to reject the proposal for resuming accession negotiations with 52.84% voting no and 47.16% voting yes.

events.title: Coup: 2026 Nigerien coup attempt
events.summary: On 28–29 August 2026, a mutinous faction of the Niger Armed Forces calling themselves the Armed Forces for the Restoration of the Fatherland attempted a coup against President Abdourahamane Tiani in the country's capital Niamey.

events.title: 2026 Guinea-Bissau constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum on expanding presidential powers was held on 30 August 2026 by the ruling military junta in Guinea-Bissau. The proposal was accepted with a majority of 70%.

events.title: 2026 Bishkek SCO summit
events.summary: The 2026 Bishkek SCO summit was the 26th meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), held from 31 August to 1 September 2026 in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

events.title: Haakon VIII takes the oath as King of Norway
events.summary: Haakon VIII takes the oath as King of Norway before the Storting following the death of his father, Harald V. His daughter, Ingrid Alexandra, takes the oath as Crown Princess.

events.title: Former British prime minister Keir Starmer resigns as a member of the House of Commons for his appointment to the…
events.summary: Former British prime minister Keir Starmer resigns as a member of the House of Commons for his appointment to the Chiltern Hundreds; a by-election will be held to fill his parlimentary seat of Holborn and St Pancras.

events.title: Second inauguration of Hakainde Hichilema
events.summary: The second inauguration of Hakainde Hichilema, as President of Zambia, took place on 1 September 2026, when he was sworn in for his second and final term, with Mutale Nalumango continuing as Vice President of Zambia.

events.title: Presidential election (by Riigikogu)
events.summary: Madise elected unopposed with 71 votes. Political Atlas, checked 25 October 2026.

events.title: 2026 Victoria and Albert Museum strikes
events.summary: Starting in September 2026, workers at the Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A) in London undertook a series of strikes as part of an ongoing industrial dispute. The strikes have included around 700 members of Prospect and the Public and Commercial Services Union (PCS), over half of the museum's employees.

events.title: Tens of thousands of people rally in Zagreb
events.summary: Tens of thousands of people rally in Zagreb, Croatia, demanding the removal of about 37,000 tonnes of illegally dumped hazardous waste from Gospić and a ban on waste imports amid concerns over soil and groundwater contamination.

events.title: United Kingdom anti-immigration protests (2025–present)
events.summary: Hundreds of masked anti-immigration protesters block the Port of Dover in Kent, England, and chant "stop the boats", causing massive disruption to traffic and train services.

events.title: The U.S. treasury department imposes sanctions against 27 Iranian airlines
events.summary: The U.S. treasury department imposes sanctions against 27 Iranian airlines, including flag carrier Iran Air, in an effort to squeeze Iran's economy.

events.title: Brazilian Supreme Court president Edson Fachin suspends conflicting rulings by two justices
events.summary: Brazilian Supreme Court president Edson Fachin suspends conflicting rulings by two justices, allowing Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues to remain in office while the court reviews allegations that police monitored justice André Mendonça and other government authorities.

events.title: 2026 Republican National Convention
events.summary: The 2026 Republican National Convention, referred to colloquially in the media and public discourse as Trumpapalooza, was held from September 9 to 10, 2026, at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, Texas, ahead of the 2026 United States midterm elections.

events.title: Sri Lanka's Supreme Court overturns a 2019 presidential pardon granted to Buddhist monk Galagoda Aththe Gnanasara and…
events.summary: Sri Lanka's Supreme Court overturns a 2019 presidential pardon granted to Buddhist monk Galagoda Aththe Gnanasara and orders him to serve the remainder of his six-year prison sentence for criminally intimidating human rights activist Sandya Eknelygoda.

events.title: 18th BRICS summit
events.summary: The 18th BRICS Summit was held at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, India from 12–13 September 2026 under India's 2026 BRICS chairship. It brought together delegations from the BRICS members, partner countries, invitees and several international organisations.

events.title: Protests against Donald Trump
events.summary: Thousands of demonstrators gather in Dublin and Doonbeg, Ireland, against U.S. president Donald Trump's visit to the country and protest against his role in the wars in Iran and Gaza.

events.title: 2026 Swedish general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Sweden on 13 September 2026 to elect the 349 members of the Riksdag, alongside municipal and regional elections.

events.title: 2026 Thai Senate election protests
events.summary: The 2026 Thai Senate election protests were a series of political demonstrations held on 13 September 2026 by civic groups, led by the Internet Law Reform Dialogue (iLaw) and allied networks, in front of the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC) in Pathum Wan District, Bangkok.

events.title: The United States House of Representatives passes a bipartisan sanctions bill that imposes sanctions on Russia's energy…
events.summary: The United States House of Representatives passes a bipartisan sanctions bill that imposes sanctions on Russia's energy revenues, financial institutions, officials, and shadow fleet, while authorizing tariffs of up to 100% on major buyers of Russian oil and gas. The bill will head to president Donald Trump's desk for his signature for it to become law.

events.title: The first summit between South Korea and the five countries of Central Asia is held in Seoul
events.summary: The first summit between South Korea and the five countries of Central Asia is held in Seoul.

events.title: Pakistan's Supreme Court suspends 17-year prison sentences imposed on human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband
events.summary: Pakistan's Supreme Court suspends 17-year prison sentences imposed on human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband over anti-state social media posts, and grants them bail pending an Islamabad High Court ruling.

events.title: Ulf Kristersson announces his resignation as Prime Minister of Sweden
events.summary: Ulf Kristersson announces his resignation as Prime Minister of Sweden after his right-wing bloc wins 173 seats in the Riksdag, compared to 176 won by the opposition, led by Magdalena Andersson.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Kohat attack
events.summary: On 18 September 2026, armed insurgents attacked and occupied the Old Police Lines complex in Kohat, Pakistan. After an initial attack on the Old Police Lines mosque, a battle and clearance operation continued for about 22 hours, resulting in 31 deaths and 103 injuries.

events.title: The U.S. treasury department lifts the sanctions against Eritrea's ruling party previously imposed by former U.S.…
events.summary: The U.S. treasury department lifts the sanctions against Eritrea's ruling party previously imposed by former U.S. president Joe Biden's administration.

events.title: 2026 Russian legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Russia from 18 to 20 September 2026, to elect all 450 seats of the 9th State Duma, the lower house of the Federal Assembly. Going into the election, United Russia was the incumbent and largest party with 310 seats.

events.title: 2026 French student protests
events.summary: Demonstrations and protests against poor school and economic conditions by lycée students have taken place in France since September 2026. In early October, the protests developed into a nationwide mobilisation involving students, teachers, parents, political organizations and trade unions, with an estimated 550,000–800,000 people participating nationwide.

events.title: European Union ambassadors agree in principle to remove Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov from…
events.summary: European Union ambassadors agree in principle to remove Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov from sanctions imposed over Russia's invasion of Ukraine, while renewing restrictions on about 3,000 other Russian-linked individuals and entities for three years. However, Latvia later blocks the deal.

events.title: UN General Assembly: general debate of the 81st session
events.summary: The general debate of the eighty-first session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) opened on 22 September and ran to 28 September 2026. Leaders from a number of member states addressed the UNGA.

events.title: 2026 Moroccan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Morocco on 23 September 2026 to elect all 395 members of the House of Representatives. The election was the 12th legislative election held in Morocco since independence in 1956. Voting took place under direct universal suffrage using a party-list proportional representation system.

events.title: 2026 state visit by Xi Jinping to the United States
events.summary: From September 23 to 25, 2026, Xi Jinping, the general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party and president of China, and his wife Peng Liyuan made a state visit to the United States, hosted by President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump. It reciprocated Trump's state visit to China in May 2026.

events.title: 2026 Spanish housing protests
events.summary: A series of protests began in Spain following the high-profile eviction on 23 September 2026 of an 87-year-old, María del Carmen "Maricarmen" Abascal, which brought the country's ongoing affordable housing crisis back into the spotlight.

events.title: 2026 French Senate election
events.summary: Senatorial elections were held in France on 27 September 2026 to select 178 members of the French Senate in indirect elections.

events.title: 2026 São Toméan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 27 September 2026. No party won an outright majority, with the MLSTP – Social Democratic Party winning a plurality of 24 seats out of 55 in the National Assembly.

events.title: Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić resigns
events.summary: Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić resigns in order to run for prime minister in the upcoming parliamentary election. Speaker of the National Assembly Ana Brnabić becomes acting president.

events.title: 2026 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2026, with national votes on 8 March, 14 June, 27 September and one planned for 29 November.

events.title: Former Turkish family minister Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya resigns from her positions in the ruling Justice and Development…
events.summary: Former Turkish family minister Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya resigns from her positions in the ruling Justice and Development Party amid scrutiny over alleged links to an investment-fund scandal that prompted the Capital Markets Board to liquidate 131 funds and led to 51 arrests.

events.title: The Supreme Court of Mexico invalidates the state of Chihuahua's authority to annul elections
events.summary: The Supreme Court of Mexico invalidates the state of Chihuahua's authority to annul elections due to interference by organized crime and instructs the local legislature to instead include the annulment of elections due to foreign interference.

events.title: Temukisa Auina Penehuro Hauma is sworn in as the first woman Governor-General of Tuvalu
events.summary: Temukisa Auina Penehuro Hauma is sworn in as the first woman Governor-General of Tuvalu.

events.title: The U.S. Supreme Court shortly after lifts the Sixth Circuit's stay order
events.summary: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit halts Christa Pike's execution in Tennessee shortly before it was scheduled, to allow for further review of whether evidence of childhood sexual abuse was adequately considered at sentencing; the U.S. Supreme Court shortly after lifts the Sixth Circuit's stay order, allowing the execution to proceed.

events.title: Gerardo Giovagnoli and William Casali are sworn in as the new Captains Regent of San Marino
events.summary: Gerardo Giovagnoli and William Casali are sworn in as the new Captains Regent of San Marino, succeeding Alice Mina and Vladimiro Selva.

events.title: 2026 French student protests
events.summary: Mass rioting continues for a third day across France with hundreds reportedly injured and over 735 schools shut, while more than 2,000 people are arrested.

events.title: Swiss president Guy Parmelin announces his resignation from the Federal Council effective December 31
events.summary: Swiss president Guy Parmelin announces his resignation from the Federal Council effective December 31. Parliament is expected to elect his successor on 9 December.

events.title: 2026 Latvian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Latvia on 3 October 2026, following the end of the term of the fourteenth Saeima elected in 2022.

events.title: 2026 Republika Srpska general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Republika Srpska on 4 October 2026 as part of the Bosnian general elections. Voters decided the President of Republika Srpska, the two Vice-Presidents of Republika Srpska, and the 83 members of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska.

events.title: 2026 Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina general election
events.summary: The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina held general elections on 4 October 2026 as part of the Bosnian general elections. Voters elected the 98 members of the House of Representatives of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, as well as the assemblies of the ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

events.title: 2026 Bosnian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 4 October 2026. They decided the makeup of the presidency as well as national, entity and cantonal governments. Voter turnout was 42.98% for the presidential election, and 44.26% for the parliamentary election, the lowest ever voter turnout for a general election in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

events.title: 2026 Brazilian general election (first round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Brazil on 4 October 2026 to elect the president, vice president, members of the National Congress, the governors, vice governors and legislative assemblies of all federative units, and the district council of Fernando de Noronha.

events.title: The International Criminal Court unseals arrest warrants for Taliban education minister Habibullah Agha and higher…
events.summary: The International Criminal Court unseals arrest warrants for Taliban education minister Habibullah Agha and higher education minister Neda Mohammad Nadeem, accusing them of the crime against humanity of gender-based persecution in Afghanistan.

events.title: 2026 French student protests
events.summary: For a second consecutive day, riots occur in Liège, Belgium, following earlier student protests, prompting authorities to close the Guillemins railway station and urge local businesses to shut down. Over 100 people are arrested.

events.title: The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil issues an arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro
events.summary: The Supreme Federal Court of Brazil issues an arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro, the brother of presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, on charges of lobbying the U.S. to interfere in the trial of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro.

events.title: 2026 Czech Senate election (first round)
events.summary: The first round of the election to the Senate, the upper house of the Parliament of the Czech Republic, were held on 9 and 10 October 2026, along with the 2026 municipal elections. In districts where second round run-off was necessary, voters elected a Senator by a simple majority on 16 and 17 October.

events.title: The Mauritanian government of Prime Minister Moctar Ould Diay resigns
events.summary: The Mauritanian government of Prime Minister Moctar Ould Diay resigns over power outages. However, President Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani reappoints Diay, asking him to form a new government.

events.title: The U.S. issues sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC)
events.summary: The U.S. issues sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC) after its former judge Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize, freezing assets held by the ICC in the U.S. and limiting U.S. companies from conducting transactions with them.

events.title: 2026 anti-CEC protests
events.summary: Indian authorities are placing New Delhi under a security lockdown and have been detaining thousands of demonstrators to block a rally organized by the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party.

events.title: Raphaël Glucksmann is elected as a candidate in the 2027 French presidential election during the Socialist Party primary
events.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann is elected as a candidate in the 2027 French presidential election during the Socialist Party primary, receiving more than 66% of the votes in the first round.

events.title: 2026 Slovenian referendum
events.summary: A four-question non-binding referendum was held in Slovenia on 11 October 2026. The questions were:Overturning the Law on Parliamentary Investigation that was adopted by the National Assembly in May 2026 Making social assistance conditional on carrying out of community service Limiting voting rights in local elections to Slovenian and EU citizens Abolition…

events.title: Ülle Madise, who was elected by the Riigikogu in September, takes office as President of Estonia
events.summary: Ülle Madise, who was elected by the Riigikogu in September, takes office as President of Estonia, succeeding Alar Karis.

events.title: The Council of the European Union approves the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia
events.summary: The Council of the European Union approves the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia, targeting 1,569 individuals and entities of the country's military and industrial complex.

events.title: 2026 Albanian student protests
events.summary: Student-led demonstrations in Albania escalated into violent clashes between protesters and police which started on 13 October 2026. The student movement began on 13 October, when demonstrators gathered outside the Ministry of Education and threw stones and other objects at the building and police.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Ireland.

events.title: 2026 Czech Senate election (second round)
events.summary: The first round of the election to the Senate, the upper house of the Parliament of the Czech Republic, were held on 9 and 10 October 2026, along with the 2026 municipal elections. In districts where second round run-off was necessary, voters elected a Senator by a simple majority on 16 and 17 October.

events.title: 2026 Italian unrest
events.summary: The 2026 Italian unrest is an ongoing series of protests, demonstrations, strikes, and clashes in Italy that began on 16 October 2026. The unrest has involved student movements and other protesters expressing discontent over the cost of living, rising fuel prices, education policies, and public spending.

events.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, who was named Prime Minister by King Mohammed VI on 29 September, takes office as her…
events.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, who was named Prime Minister by King Mohammed VI on 29 September, takes office as her four-party coalition Government is formally appointed.

events.title: Gen Z protests
events.summary: Yellow vests activists hold mass demonstrations across France against rising fuel prices and join the student protests.

events.title: Protests against Donald Trump
events.summary: The fourth round of No Kings protests are held across the United States against president Donald Trump and his administration and to encourage early voting ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

events.title: 2026 Alberta independence referendum
events.summary: The independence question of the 2026 Alberta referendum is one of 10 questions of the 2026 Alberta referendum election, which took place on October 19, 2026. The question was a choice of two options: whether to remain in Canada or for the province of Alberta to take steps toward holding a binding referendum on separating from Canada.

events.title: 2026 Alberta referendum
events.summary: On October 19, 2026 a referendum was held in Alberta on ten separate ballot questions, one of which addressed Albertan independence from Canada. Alberta premier Danielle Smith had previously announced the referendum in February of the same year. In her address, she announced that Albertans will be asked to vote on nine questions.

events.title: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is sworn in as the 34th premier of Quebec
events.summary: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is sworn in as the 34th premier of Quebec, Canada, following the Parti Québécois's victory in the general election.

events.title: The Australian Government imposes financial sanctions and travel bans on two North Koreans and sanctions two companies…
events.summary: The Australian Government imposes financial sanctions and travel bans on two North Koreans and sanctions two companies accused of supporting fraudulent overseas information technology work that funds North Korea's weapons programs.

events.title: Premier David Eby resigns as NDP leader
events.summary: The Conservative Party of British Columbia wins the provincial snap election in Canada, returning to government for the first time in nearly a century and ending nine years of New Democratic Party (NDP) rule. Premier David Eby resigns as NDP leader.

events.title: 2026 European unrest
events.summary: The Yellow vests hold a second wave of mass demonstrations across France. About 410,000 people participate and over 1,000 people are arrested.

events.title: Party leader Marine Le Pen holds the National Rally congress in Orléans
events.summary: Party leader Marine Le Pen holds the National Rally congress in Orléans, France. Protesters, including left-wing politicians, marched in opposition.

events.title: Thousands of Israelis rally in Hostages Square in Tel Aviv
events.summary: Thousands of Israelis rally in Hostages Square in Tel Aviv to protest against the government, prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet, and the continuation of the Gaza war.

events.title: 2026 Brazilian general election (second round)
events.summary: General elections were held in Brazil on 4 October 2026 to elect the president, vice president, members of the National Congress, the governors, vice governors and legislative assemblies of all federative units, and the district council of Fernando de Noronha.

events.title: 2026 Bulgarian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 25 October 2026. Incumbent president Iliana Iotova is eligible and has declared her intention to run for a full term.

events.title: 2026 Serbian parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 25 October 2026 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were originally due by December 2027; Aleksandar Vučić, then the president of Serbia, dissolved the National Assembly and called the elections on 9 September 2026, on the proposal of the government.

events.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections are scheduled to be held in Israel on 27 October 2026, to elect all 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

events.title: 2026 Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting
events.summary: The 2026 Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, also known as CHOGM 2026, is scheduled to be the 28th Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, bringing together leaders and representatives of the 56 member states of the Commonwealth of Nations. It is to be held in St. John's, Antigua and Barbuda, from 1 to 4 November 2026.

events.title: 2026 Bulgarian presidential election (second round)
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 25 October 2026. Incumbent president Iliana Iotova is eligible and has declared her intention to run for a full term.

events.title: 2026 Navajo Nation presidential election
events.summary: The 2026 Navajo Nation presidential election will take place on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to elect the president and vice president of the Navajo Nation. The primary election was held on June 2 in New Mexico, June 23 in Utah, and July 21 in Arizona to align with each state's primary elections.

events.title: 2026 United States Senate elections
events.summary: The 2026 United States Senate elections are scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026, with 33 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections. In these elections, voters will elect candidates to six-year terms that begin on January 3, 2027, and expire on January 3, 2033.

events.title: 2026 United States House of Representatives elections
events.summary: The 2026 United States House of Representatives elections are scheduled to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, as part of the 2026 midterm elections during President Donald Trump's second nonconsecutive term. Voters will elect representatives from all 435 congressional districts across each of the fifty U.S.

events.title: 2026 Grenadian general election
events.summary: General elections are scheduled to be held in Grenada on 5 November 2026.

events.title: 2026 New Zealand general election
events.summary: The 2026 New Zealand general election is scheduled to be held on 7 November 2026. Voters will elect 120 members to the House of Representatives under New Zealand's mixed-member proportional (MMP) voting system, comprising 71 members elected from single-member electorates and 49 members elected from closed party lists to achieve proportionality.

events.title: COP31: 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference
events.summary: The 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference or Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC, more commonly known as COP31, is the upcoming 31st session of the United Nations Climate Change Conference, to be held at the Expo Center in Antalya, Turkey from 9 to 20 November 2026.

events.title: 9th European Political Community Summit
events.summary: The Ninth European Political Community Summit is a meeting of the European Political Community to be held on 12 November 2026 in Ireland.

events.title: European Council meeting (informal)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (informal meeting). Council presidency: Ireland.

events.title: 2026 Cape Verdean presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Cape Verde on 15 November 2026.

events.title: 2026 ASEAN Summits
events.summary: The 2026 ASEAN Summits are two series of diplomatic conferences centering on the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), which are held in the Philippines in 2026. It comprised the 48th ASEAN Summit held on 6–8 May in Cebu and the 49th ASEAN Summit scheduled for 16–18 November in Metro Manila.

events.title: APEC China 2026
events.summary: The APEC China 2026 will be a year-long hosting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meetings, which will conclude with the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in November 2026. It will be the third time China hosted the summit, having previously hosted in 2001 and 2014.

events.title: European Council meeting (extraordinary)
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (extraordinary meeting). Council presidency: Ireland.

events.title: 2026 Taiwanese referendum
events.summary: A referendum is scheduled to be held in Taiwan on 28 November 2026 asking voters if the country should adopt nuclear power. The referendum will take place alongside local elections.

events.title: 2026 Spanish general election
events.summary: A general election will be held in Spain on 29 November 2026 to elect the members of the 16th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies will be up for election, as well as 209 of 267 seats in the Senate.

events.title: 2026 Swiss referendums
events.summary: Several referendums were held in Switzerland during 2026, with national votes on 8 March, 14 June, 27 September and one planned for 29 November.

events.title: 2026 Gambian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in the Gambia on 5 December 2026. Incumbent president Adama Barrow is running for a third term.

events.title: 2026 Fijian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum has been provisionally scheduled to be held in Fiji on 9 December 2026 to determine whether to approve the draft of a new Constitution. While Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka has announced the referendum date, it cannot take place unless parliament approves the third reading of the constitutional amendment bill.

events.title: 2026 G20 Miami summit
events.summary: The 2026 G20 Doral Summit will be the twenty-first meeting of the Group of Twenty (G20), a meeting of heads of state and government planned from 14 to 15 December 2026. It will be held at the Trump National Doral Miami, a property of the host, U.S. president Donald Trump, in Doral, Florida.

events.title: European Council meeting
events.summary: EU heads of state or government meet as the European Council (scheduled meeting). Council presidency: Ireland.

events.title: 2026 South Sudanese general election
events.summary: General elections are due to be held in South Sudan on 22 December 2026, the first since independence.

events.title: 2026 Serbian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections will be held in Serbia by 26 December 2026 to elect the president of Serbia, following the resignation of Aleksandar Vučić to run for prime minister in the 2026 parliamentary election. Vučić is ineligible to run again as president, as he has served two consecutive terms.

events.title: 2027 Nigerian general election
events.summary: General elections will be held in Nigeria on 16 January 2027 to elect the president and vice president, members of the Senate and House of Representatives. Elections to elect state governors, and members of the house of assembly will be held on 6 February 2027.

events.title: 2027 Kyrgyz presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Kyrgyzstan on 27 January 2027. Incumbent president Sadyr Japarov has announced that he will seek a second term in office.

events.title: 2027 Salvadoran presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in El Salvador on 28 February 2027, three years after the 2024 presidential election. They will occur with concurrent legislative and municipal elections. In July 2025, the Legislative Assembly of El Salvador voted to move the date of the next presidential election from 2029 to 2027.

events.title: 2027 Salvadoran legislative election
events.summary: Legislative and municipal elections are scheduled to be held in El Salvador on 28 February 2027, three years after the 2024 legislative election. Salvadorans will elect all 60 members of the Legislative Assembly of El Salvador and all members of the country's 44 municipal councils. The election will occur with concurrent presidential elections.

events.summary: Parliamentary elections are expected to take place in Andorra no later than 5 June 2027. Incumbent prime minister Xavier Espot is incapable of running again due to the country's two term limit for the office.

events.summary: The Tenth European Political Community Summit is a meeting of the European Political Community to be held in April 2027 in the Switzerland.

events.title: 2027 Gambian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in The Gambia on 10 April 2027.

events.title: 2027 Finnish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections will be held in Finland on 18 April 2027 to elect members of parliament for the 2027–2031 term. It will be the first parliamentary election in Finland since the country acceded to NATO on 4 April 2023, ending 75 years of military non-alignment for the country.

events.title: 2027 French presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in France on 18 April 2027, with a second round on 2 May if no candidate secures a majority vote. The election may be held earlier under exceptional circumstances if the presidency falls vacant before then.

events.title: 2027 Mexican legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections are scheduled to be held in Mexico on 6 June 2027. Voters will elect all 500 members of the Chamber of Deputies, who will serve during the LXVII Legislature (2027–2030). These elections will take place concurrently with the 2027 state elections.

events.title: 2027 Guatemalan general election
events.summary: General elections will be held in Guatemala in June 2027 to elect the president and vice president, all 160 seats in Congress, all 20 Guatemalan members of the Central American Parliament, and mayors and councils for all the country's 340 municipalities, with a second round of the presidential elections to be held in August if no candidate wins a majority…

events.title: 2027 Kenyan general election
events.summary: The 2027 Kenyan general election is scheduled to be held on 10 August 2027 to elect the President, members of the National Assembly, senators, county governors, women representatives and members of county assemblies.
